data.name: R.A.M. - Tank Combat
data.description_full:
**R.A.M - Tank Combat** is a top-down armored warfare game built around realistic tank combat, detailed damage modeling, and tactical decision-making.

Forget traditional health bars. In R.A.M, destroying an enemy tank means actually defeating its crew, ammunition, engine, transmission, or other critical components. Every shot matters.

### REALISTIC ARMOR COMBAT

Armor thickness, armor angle, shell penetration, impact angle, and remaining penetration energy all affect what happens when a round hits.

A successful penetration doesn't simply subtract health. Shells travel through the interior of the vehicle, producing fragments and damaging whatever lies in their path.

Aim carefully. A shot through the driver's position can disable the crew. Hit the ammunition and you may cause a catastrophic cook-off. Destroy the engine or transmission and leave an enemy unable to escape.

### HISTORICAL VEHICLES

Command tanks and armored vehicles from multiple nations, including:

• USA
• Germany
• USSR / Russia

Vehicles are built around their real-world characteristics, including armor layouts, mobility, turret traverse, reload speeds, ammunition and weapon performance.

From fast early-war light tanks to heavily armored machines carrying devastating guns, every vehicle is designed to feel different.

### RESEARCH AND UNLOCK NEW VEHICLES

Progress through national technology trees and unlock increasingly powerful vehicles.

Choose which branches to research, learn the strengths and weaknesses of your tanks, and build your way toward some of history's most formidable armored vehicles.

### TACTICAL TOP-DOWN COMBAT

Positioning matters.

Use your mobility to flank stronger enemies, protect vulnerable armor, angle your tank, choose the correct ammunition and strike critical components before your opponent can do the same.

A powerful tank alone won't guarantee victory.

Knowledge will.

**Recon. Assault. Maneuver.**

Master your vehicle. Learn the armor. Make every shot count.
data.description_short: Realistic top-down tank combat with detailed armor and damage simulation.

data.name: City Construction Sim 3D
data.description_full:
Climb into the cab and start building. Excavator City Construction puts you in control of real heavy machinery across a living city that grows with every mission you finish. Dig foundations, haul materials, swing a crane load into place, and watch a skyline rise because of the work you did.

This is a construction simulator built around one idea: every machine should feel like it has weight and purpose. The excavator controls respond the way a real operator would expect. The dump truck handles load and distance. The crane system demands patience and precision. Nothing is there just for show.

Construction Missions That Actually Progress

Each mission in this construction game is a step in a larger build. Early levels establish the groundwork, clearing sites and moving earth with the excavator simulator. Mid-game missions bring in cranes and truck convoys. Late-game city construction tasks chain everything together so you are coordinating multiple machines on a single site. The city you see at the end of the campaign is the one you built, piece by piece.

Heavy Machinery, Handled Right

The heavy machinery simulator covers the machines that actually run a construction site. You get an excavator with full articulation, a dump truck simulator with load physics, and a crane that swings and locks to real tolerances. Each vehicle has its own control scheme, so switching between them takes a moment to learn and a long time to master.

Real City Construction Environments

The game takes place across real city construction zones: cleared lots, half-finished roads, riverside developments, and a downtown core that fills in as you advance. Each zone has its own ground type, obstacle layout, and time pressure, so the realistic simulator challenge stays fresh across every location.

Why Players Keep Coming Back

A realistic excavator simulator is only as good as its feedback loop, and this one gives you visible, measurable progress at every stage. You can see the trench you dug, the platform you levelled, and the structure that now stands where there was nothing. That is the construction game loop that keeps operators coming back: do the work, see the result, move to the next job.

Key Things You Can Do

Operate a full excavator simulator with responsive dig and swing controls. Run a dump truck simulator across loaded haul routes. Work a crane through precision lift-and-place tasks. Complete construction missions in a sequence that builds toward a finished city. Drive and switch between heavy machinery on active sites. Experience a heavy machinery simulator with grounded, realistic controls. Take on real city construction challenges across varied urban zones.

If you have played truck simulator games offline and wanted more structure, or you enjoy construction games but find pure sandbox too open-ended, this is the game that fills that space. A real city construction sim, grounded in the machines that actually build cities.

data.name: Forest Screw: Match Cash
data.description_full:
Forest Screw: Match Cash is a screw puzzle game built around logic puzzle boards, sequence planning, and step-by-step solving. Study each board, tap the right screw, use screw match logic, and clear every screw puzzle level one move at a time.

Each screw puzzle level asks you to read shapes, colors, blocked plates, and open holes before you move. Every board works like a brain teaser: plan the order, test safe moves, and solve the puzzle board without trapping the layers.

🎮 How to Play

Inspect the full screw puzzle board like a logic puzzle before you tap. Find which screw pin can move, which plate is blocked, and which open hole can help. Use an unscrew puzzle plan when layers overlap or hide the next clear move.

Tap screws in the right order, match animal-shaped pieces, and move each screw pin to an available slot. Treat every screw pin puzzle like a compact brain teaser: clear the upper layer, open space, and keep the screw puzzle board from getting stuck.

🌟 Main Features

  • 🔩 Logic Puzzle Boards - Solve screw puzzle levels with colorful ducks, birds, flowers, and forest shapes.

  • 🧩 Screw Match Flow - Use screw match moves to pair animal layers, compare colors, and keep the solving sequence clear.

  • 🔧 Unscrew Strategy - Use unscrew puzzle thinking to compare holes, remove blockers, and find a cleaner route.

  • 💰 Step-by-Step Solving - After board goals are cleared, move into the next screw puzzle layout with a new blocker pattern.

  • 🌲 Forest Puzzle Theme - Solve nut puzzle layouts with forest shapes, tool-based rules, and clear board goals.



Each new logic puzzle is about order, not speed. Read the blocker pattern, choose the next open hole, and use screw match choices to build a clean solving path.

Some screw puzzle boards look easy to clear at first, while other nut puzzle layouts need a better order. Try another unscrew puzzle route, watch each screw pin, and use each open hole before the board fills up.

Try Forest Screw: Match Cash for screw puzzle practice with screw match moments, a screw pin puzzle challenge, brain teaser boards, and forest puzzle layouts!

data.name: Tiny Medical Idle
data.description_full:
Tiny Medical Idle is a relaxing, stress-relieving idle casual hospital simulation game. Step into the role of a hospital director, build your very own miniature medical paradise from scratch, and enjoy the simple, comforting fun of hospital management.

The game features five independent medical production lines: Outpatient Clinic, CT Room, Operating Room, Pharmacy, and Ward. These five lines run separately, generating resources and gold coins respectively with no mandatory workflow connections. The Outpatient Clinic receives incoming patients and provides steady basic income, serving as the core for early capital accumulation. The CT Room operates with professional medical equipment to deliver higher single-session returns. The Operating Room boasts high earnings and is the key line for amassing large amounts of gold coins. The Pharmacy runs non-stop, consistently bringing in considerable revenue. The Ward generates a steady stream of income to support the steady expansion of your hospital. Each line fulfills its own function. You are free to choose your priority development direction, with full control over your gameplay pace.

Use the gold coins earned from operations to upgrade and strengthen the five production lines. Upgrades improve processing efficiency, raise the maximum single-session yield, and speed up overall operation. When a production line reaches specific levels, brand-new workstations and a wealth of exquisite themed decorations will be unlocked. Upgrading the Outpatient Clinic unlocks more consultation workstations, along with decorative items such as modern desks, chairs and medical record cabinets. Upgrading the CT Room unlocks brand-new scanning equipment paired with sleek, tech-inspired medical ornaments. Upgrading the Operating Room opens more surgical workstations and unlocks sterile-style scene decorations. Upgrading the Pharmacy expands dispensing workstations and unlocks a wide array of medicine shelves and display props. Upgrading the Ward unlocks more hospital beds, as well as soft furnishings including curtains, nightstands and green plants. All decorations can be freely used to spruce up your hospital, and some also provide extra stat bonuses, boosting both your hospital’s appearance and profit-making ability at the same time.

The game focuses on a laid-back idle experience, with no brain-taxing complex strategic puzzles or stressful time-limited missions, making it perfect for playing in short, fragmented sessions. While the game is running, all production lines operate automatically and gold coins keep accumulating. All you need to do is continuously reinvest your earnings into upgrading and expanding your hospital.

data.name: GoreBox 27
data.description_full:
GoreBox 27 is a physics-driven sandbox shooter. Every character is a full ragdoll with its own skeleton, organs and blood system.

Play on your own, against bots, or online with other players. Fight, experiment, or explore user created maps.

PHYSICS AND DAMAGE
• Damage is calculated per limb, tracking broken bones, organ damage and blood loss from the exact point of impact
• Shoot someone in the leg and they lose their balance. Break an arm and they drop what they were carrying
• Knockouts, concussion and crawling, with characters that can recover or bleed out
• Blood and wounds stay on characters and on the environment
• Limbs can be severed
• The same damage system applies to your own character, including bruises, cuts and torn clothing
• Check your character's vitals and organ function with the Body Inspector

WEAPONS
• A wide range of firearms, each with its own recoil, handling and sound based on real calibres
• Bullets penetrate walls and cover
• The Reality Crusher: spawn objects, grab them, throw them and tear them apart

BOTS AND NPCS
• NPCs react to danger in different ways. Some fight back, some run, some surrender
• Bots use cover, reload behind it, track you by sound and remember who attacked them
• Adjustable difficulty, from easy target practice to opponents that will beat you
• Dozens of unique characters with their own names, appearances and backgrounds

MULTIPLAYER
• Crossplay across every platform GoreBox 27 is available on
• Host a game for friends, join by invite, or browse public sessions
• Add bots to fill out a small lobby
• Host tools including kicks, vote kicks and in-game chat
• LAN play

GAME MODES
• Sandbox, with no rules or objectives
• Maniac Mystery
• Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch and Gun Game
• Play any mode against bots

WORLD
• A day and night cycle and changing weather
• Water you can swim in, dive under and drown in

CREATE YOUR OWN
• Build maps in the in-game editor and play them straight away
• Customise your character, down to the face
• Create your own NPCs, save them and place them in your maps

Full controller support, and touch controls on mobile.

EARLY ACCESS
GoreBox 27 is only a few months old, so you will run into bugs and nothing you see here is final. It has far less content than GoreBox Animosity for now, and new updates will keep adding more. If you find a bug, please report it on our Discord server.

GoreBox 27 contains graphic violence, blood and gore, and online interaction with other players. It is not made for children, and player discretion is advised.

data.name: Junglee Rummy Master
data.description_full:
This is a simulation game intended for entertainment purposes only.

For users aged 18 and over.

This game does not involve real-money gambling and does not offer any opportunity to win real money, cash prizes, or real-world rewards.

All virtual coins, chips, credits, bonuses, and rewards are fictional and can only be used within the game.

No purchases or gameplay outcomes can be exchanged for money or items of value.

Success in this simulation game does not imply future success in real-money gambling.

【How to play】
One standard 52-card deck (no jokers), four players at the table.

Each player starts with 7 cards. The rest form the stock; one card opens the discard pile.

On your turn, draw from the stock or take the top discard.
After drawing, you may lay melds from your hand:
• Set: 3–4 cards of the same rank
• Run: 3+ consecutive cards of the same suit

End every turn by discarding exactly one card.
The first player to empty their hand wins the round and scores the deadwood left in opponents’ hands (A=1, face cards=10, others face value).
First to 100 practice points wins the match.

data.name: Picture Blocks: Living Puzzles
data.description_full:
A picture gently comes to life. Snow drifts past a glowing cabin. Lanterns sway above a night market. Otters turn slowly through the water.

Then the picture breaks into pieces. As you rebuild it, the world inside keeps moving.

BUILD IT YOUR WAY

There is no frame to fill and no fixed grid to follow. Connect the first two pieces and the picture begins to grow from there. Start from the centre, build separate clusters, or follow the colours that catch your eye. Where you begin and how you progress are entirely up to you.

THE CHALLENGE IS IN THE PICTURE

Early levels guide you with bold shapes and distinct colours. As you progress, the artwork reveals less: repeating leaves, stretches of ice with no clear position, patterns that echo at exactly the size of a piece. Later pictures become a true test of patience and observation.

NOT EVERY PIECE THAT FITS IS RIGHT

Sometimes a piece settles perfectly into the wrong place—and the game will let it stay. When the surrounding picture refuses to come together, you will need to find the piece that misled you and think again. Move it to its rightful place, and everything else begins to fall into line.

NO NEED TO RUSH

No timers. No lives. No losing. If you want to track your time and moves, you can see them at the end of each level. Leave halfway through a picture and everything will be waiting exactly where you left it. The challenge comes from the image, never from pressure.

MADE TO BE TOUCHED

Large, flat pieces designed for your thumb. Every connection lands with a satisfying click you can hear and feel. If you love the quiet focus of a jigsaw puzzle, you will find that same absorbing pleasure here in a different form.

HELP WHEN YOU WANT IT

Begin with three hints and earn more as you play. Each hint places a single piece where it belongs—just enough help to keep you moving, without solving the puzzle for you.

HIGHLIGHTS

* Living pictures that continue moving as you solve them
* A gentle beginning that grows into a genuine challenge
* Free-form assembly with no frame or fixed grid
* Pieces that can fit in the wrong place
* Large blocks designed for one-handed play
* Calming ambient sound, muted with a tap
* Hints earned through play
* Progress saved automatically
* No ads, no in-app purchases, no sign-up

Ten minutes before sleep. A bus ride. A quiet waiting room. One picture at a time.
data.description_short: Rebuild living pictures piece by piece. Calm to play, hard to master.

data.name: Break & Build Simulator

Start with an old camper, a piece of land and a dream of building your own construction company.

Take your first demolition contract and grab your hammer. Smash old structures, clear the site and get paid for the work. Then discover new tools and new ways to earn.

Use an axe to become a lumberjack and collect wood.
Use a pickaxe to break rocks and gather stone.
Carry materials on your back, load them onto your trailer and deliver everything to the construction site.

Then build.

Complete construction projects, help citizens with their requests and take on bigger contracts from the city. Tear down an old fountain and replace it with something new. Clear forgotten areas, rebuild locations and help the town grow one project at a time.

Start with small jobs and work your way toward larger construction and demolition projects.

• Demolish old structures and clean up construction sites
• Chop trees and collect wood
• Mine rocks and gather materials
• Carry resources using the arcade backpack system
• Transport materials with vehicles and trailers
• Build and develop new structures
• Complete contracts and earn money
• Upgrade your tools, vehicles and equipment
• Unlock bigger and more profitable projects
• Expand your construction company

DRIVE WITH YOUR TRAILER

Your business needs transportation.

Buy better vehicles, attach trailers and transport materials around the town. Driving a vehicle with a trailer is a core part of the experience — load your cargo, hook up your trailer and deliver the right materials to the right construction site.

As your company grows, your transport fleet grows with it.

BUILD YOUR CREW

You don't have to do every job alone.

Hire assistants who can travel with you to construction sites and help you get more work done. Your crew becomes part of your growing business as projects become larger and more demanding.

This is construction work with an arcade twist.

TOOLS THAT CHANGE THE WAY YOU WORK

Start with simple hand tools and gradually unlock better equipment.

Use a hammer, axe and pickaxe to get your company started, then discover powerful equipment such as chainsaws and electric demolition hammers.

New tools open new opportunities, new jobs and new ways to make money.

IDLE EARNINGS, ARCADE GAMEPLAY

Carry. Deliver. Build. Destroy. Clean. Earn. Upgrade.

The game combines hands-on arcade gameplay with idle progression. Work on projects yourself, grow your company and build up your income as your business expands.

Every job helps you move toward bigger contracts and better equipment.

CREATE YOUR OWN COMPANY

Your company is yours.

Choose your own company name and turn your construction business into whatever you want it to be. Make it serious, professional or completely ridiculous.

From a tiny operation with an old camper to a growing construction and demolition business — build your company your way.

DEMOLITION. CONSTRUCTION. TRANSPORT. BUSINESS.

Break old things.
Clear the land.
Collect resources.
Load your trailer.
Deliver materials.
Build something new.
Upgrade your equipment.
Hire your crew.
Take bigger contracts.
Grow your company.

Break & Build Simulator combines construction simulator gameplay, demolition, building, driving, resource collection, idle progression and arcade mechanics into one hands-on business adventure.

Can you turn a forgotten piece of land into a construction company that runs the whole town?

data.name: Jhand Munda Master

Jhand Munda Master is a digital dice-based game inspired by the traditional Jhand Munda game. Players interact with a set of virtual dice and observe the symbols shown after each round.

Game Features

Simple Dice Gameplay
The game uses six-sided virtual dice. Each die displays one of several different symbols after a roll, creating a straightforward and easy-to-follow game flow.

Round-Based Play
Each round begins with a dice roll. Once the dice stop, the displayed symbols are shown on the game screen before the next round starts.

Clear Game Interface
The main gameplay screen presents the dice, symbols, and round information in an organized layout, allowing players to understand the current game state easily.

Symbol Matching
Players can observe the symbols appearing on the dice and follow the results of each round. Different combinations create different visual outcomes during gameplay.

Virtual Game Experience
Jhand Munda Master is designed as a simulated entertainment experience. All game elements are virtual and are intended only for use within the application.

How to Play
Start a new round.
Interact with the virtual dice.
Wait for the dice to stop.
View the symbols displayed on the dice.
Continue to the next round and repeat the gameplay.

Jhand Munda Master focuses on simple dice interaction, symbol recognition, and round-based gameplay in a straightforward mobile format.

This game is intended for an adult audience (18+) for amusement purposes only. This game does not target minors and does not offer real-money gambling or any opportunity to win real money or prizes. Practice or success at social casino gaming does not imply future success at real-money gambling.

Tap once. Every wisp you catch sets off the next, and the next, and the next.
Aim well and the chain cascades. Miss the goal and the expedition ends.
How far does one tap get you?

Wisps are ancient light, condensed starstuff, adrift since before anyone was
counting. Burst one and it comes apart into stardust. That burst wakes the
wisps around it, and they burst too.

You are a stardust miner. You get one charge a stage. Everything after that is
the sky doing it to itself.

Seven kinds of wisp, each with its own burst radius. Learn the reach of every
one and the sky stops being random. The rare Gold Nova is worth hunting for.

No two skies are the same. Procedurally generated nebulae, auroras, moons,
eclipses and mountain ranges are built fresh every expedition.

Ascension Mode:
EVERY STAGE, A CHOICE
Clear a stage and three cards come up. Take one. Wider bursts, critical bursts,
echoes that throw a second burst, magnetism that leans the whole field toward
your shot — eleven upgrades across six rarities, and no two expeditions build
the same way.

UNLOCK AS YOU PLAY
• 8 blasters, from a scattering spread to a ricochet that bounces off the walls
• 8 wisp forms and 8 burst shapes, including a collapsing black hole
• Stardust in seven colours — every wisp you burst pays out, and the harvest is yours to keep
• Skill points, upgrade ladders and a global leaderboard
• Build and share your own stages

FAIR BY DESIGN
• Free, with no in-app purchases — everything is earned by playing
• No interstitials. Ads are optional and rewarded only: watch one if you want a second chance, skip them entirely and nothing is locked away
• Plays offline
• English, Spanish and Portuguese
data.description_short: One tap. One burst. Chase the longest chain you can.

data.name: Glowcatch
data.description_full:
GLOWCATCH
Catch the light, re-light the sleeping forest.

Glowcatch is a one-thumb night-time arcade game. You are the last firefly catcher, drifting a glass jar through moonlit glades to collect the glowing insects that will re-light a sleeping forest.

PLAY: DRAG AND CATCH
Control is one finger. Drag in the bottom zone of the screen to steer your jar through the night. Glide close to a firefly and slow down — when the jar gently touches it, the firefly hops inside and adds its light to your jar. Move too fast and the firefly startles and flies away, so every chase is a choice between speed and stealth.

PROGRESS: LIGHT AND GLOW DUST
Every catch spends a little jar light, and jar light is also your run: when it runs out, your night is over. New fireflies fill the jar with glow and earn Glow Dust, a permanent currency you can spend to unlock more glades. Watch a rewarded ad to refill your jar once per round.

COLLECT: THE FIREFLY ATLAS
The forest is home to more than forty common fireflies and twelve legendary ones. Fill your atlas by catching each species, read their lore, and track your collection across four night regions: the Forest Edge, the Forest Depth, the Canopy, and the Ancient Grove. Re-light every region to complete your journey.

More than forty fireflies. Ten glades. Four night forests. One thumb, one jar — and a forest waiting to glow again.
data.description_short: Glowcatch is a one-thumb night-time arcade game.

data.name: Traffic Flow: Idle Tycoon Game
data.description_full:
Traffic Flow is a clean, hypnotic idle game about one thing: moving people into
seats.

Passengers arrive as a glowing queue. They check in at the gate, walk the path,
step through the door and take a seat. Every seat that fills pays you. Fill the
whole vehicle and it departs, then the next one rolls in and the queue starts
again.

YOUR JOB IS THE BOTTLENECK

You never drive anything. You find whatever is slowing the line down and you fix
it. Three upgrade tracks, thirty levels each:

GATE. Faster check in, instant check in, and higher check in income.
TRANSIT. Faster walking, faster boarding, and income at the door.
SEATING. Faster seating, instant seating, and higher income per seat.

Push one track and the queue backs up somewhere else. Balancing all three is the
whole game.

FROM ONE SMALL PLANE TO A GLOBAL NETWORK

You start with a short hop out of Dublin and a plane with a few dozen seats.
Earn enough and you move up to a wide body jet where premium rows pay several
times what economy does, then to entirely new kinds of transit:

Planes. Long routes, big cabins, premium seating up front.
Buses. Short hops that turn over fast.
Trains. Multiple cars filling at the same time.
Ships. Huge twin aisle decks and the longest passenger queues in the game.

Each vehicle type is opened by a one time certificate from the research screen,
so every unlock is a real step change rather than another percentage.

ROUTES AND CITIES

The player hub is a route map for each vehicle type. Pick a city, see its seat
count and its income ceiling, and switch your run to it. Dublin, Singapore,
Cambridge, Brussels, Bilbao and more, each with a different mix of economy and
premium seats.

NUMBERS THAT ACTUALLY GO UP

Your first plane earns a few hundred a minute. Late game ships earn billions a
minute. The jump from hundreds to billions is the point, and you can watch every
step of it happen on one screen.

BUILT TO BE CALM

No timers pressuring you, no lives, no fail state. Pure neon on black, a readable
grid of seats, and a queue you can watch for as long as you like. Play with sound
off. Play one handed. Put it down mid boarding and pick it up later.
data.description_short: Fill every seat, speed up every queue, and grow one plane into a global network!

data.name: Arrow Flow Puzzle
data.description_full:
Arrow Flow Puzzle: Tap the Triangle, Clear the Path!
Welcome to Arrow Flow Puzzle, a unique and relaxing casual puzzle game! Each level is filled with line segments ending in a triangular arrowhead. Your task is simple: tap on the triangle head of any segment, and the entire line will slide off the screen in the direction the arrow points. Clear all segments to complete the level. But be careful – lines may cross or block each other, requiring you to choose the right order to solve the puzzle. With hundreds of cleverly designed stages, this game challenges your logic while keeping you calm and entertained.
Game Features:
- Innovative Tap-to-Remove Mechanic: Unlike typical matching games, you directly interact with arrowheads. One tap removes the whole line in its pointed direction – satisfying and intuitive.
- Puzzle & Strategy: Decide which arrow to tap first. Some lines may be blocked by others; plan your sequence to clear the board efficiently.
- Hundreds of Levels: Gradually increasing difficulty from simple straight lines to complex intersecting webs.

data.name: Arrow Jam: Tap Away
data.description_full:
🎯 Simple taps, satisfying clears
Arrow Jam: Tap Away is a casual puzzle built around one relaxing idea—tap arrows, send them flying, and watch the board slowly empty. It’s an easy loop that fits right into quiet moments.

🧩 Clear the board your way
Each level is filled with colorful arrow tiles pointing in different directions. Tap an arrow that points outward, and it zips off the screen. Clearing one tile often unlocks another, creating a gentle chain of small wins that keeps your fingers moving.

💡 Light strategy, no stress
Some arrows hide behind others, and some layouts need a bit of planning. You’ll learn to spot the right tap, free up blocked pieces, and clear the whole puzzle at your own pace. There’s no timer, no wrong move—just room to think and play.

🌈 Bright looks, calm feel
The visuals are clean and colorful without being loud. Each tap lands with a crisp, satisfying response, and the board clears with a smooth, tidy motion. It’s a small visual treat that makes every level feel rewarding.

⚙️ Made for everyday play
The interface stays out of the way, levels are short enough for a quick break, and the difficulty ramps up gently. Whether you play for two minutes or twenty, Arrow Jam matches your mood and never rushes you.

😌 A little pocket of calm
No noisy clutter, no complicated systems—just a polished arrow puzzle that gives your brain something light to do. Open it up, tap away a few boards, and step back feeling a bit more settled.
data.description_short: Tap arrows, clear the jam, and unwind. A satisfying casual puzzle game.

data.name: Pirate Runner: Skill & Slay
data.description_full:
Sprint into a dark fantasy pirate world where every second counts!

Charge through cursed seas, dodge deadly traps, and unleash devastating skills on monstrous sea bosses. Pirate Runner blends lightning-fast runner reflexes with action-RPG combat — a hybrid built for players who want more depth than tap-to-jump but more pace than turn-based grind.

Action Runner + RPG Combat
• One-tap jump & swipe-slide through 100 hand-tuned stages packed with traps, pits, and obstacles.
• Perfect Dodge mechanic — frame-perfect timing triggers slow-mo and bonus coins.
• 3 signature skills per captain on cooldown — strike enemies, chip boss HP, mix tactics on the fly.
• Mana regenerates as you run — your movement IS your power.

10 Epic Boss Battles
Forget faceless mooks. Every chapter ends in a cinematic boss arena: Crab King, Coral Titan, Lava Serpent, Flame Drake, Volcano Lord and more. Each boss has unique attack patterns — coconut barrages, fire claws, quicksand summons, ground slams. Read the patterns, dodge, strike back, survive.

6 Legendary Captains
Recruit and master a roster of distinct heroes — no faceless avatar here:
• Rune-Eye Roder — Mystic swordsman: Cutlass Slash · Rune Cannon · Ghost Armada
• Grimlock Bonefire — Skull-marked gunner: Skullshot · Triple Shot · Skull Cannon
• Ironclad Drake — Heavy striker: Lightning Arrow · Twin Wave · Blade Barrage
• Grimvault Kane — Glass-cannon demolitionist: Round Shot · Brick Charge · Core Detonation
• Isla Swiftblade — Agile duelist: Swift Thrust · Flash Wave · Crimson Lunge
• Nerissa Tidebinder — Water mage: Aqua Orb · Tidal Burst · Abyss Sphere

Level them up. Upgrade stats. Unlock new captains via shards as you progress.

Deep Progression — No Pay-to-Win
• 100 stages across stormy seas, coral reefs, sunken vaults, volcanic islands and ghost fleets.
• Endless Mode with adaptive difficulty — how long can you survive?
• Captain leveling scales ATK, Crit, Mana Regen and HP.
• Equipment system — sword, helmet, armor and more, with 6 rarity tiers from Common to Mythic.
• Daily Missions and Daily Challenges with streaks and records.
• Mutator events shake every run — gravity flips, double coins, transformation modes.

Built for Mobile
• 3-5 minute sessions — perfect for commutes and coffee breaks.
• Skill matters more than spending — no pay-to-win walls.
• Optional rewarded ads for 2× gold, revives or free fragments.
• Fair, optional IAP for cosmetics and bundles.

Dark Fantasy Pirate, Not Saturday-Morning Cartoon
Cursed fleets. Bone-motif arcana. Briny smoke and steel. Pirate Runner trades tropical-treasure pastiche for a gothic, swashbuckling, runic atmosphere. Magic, gunpowder and ghosts — together.

What Are You Waiting For?
Pick your captain. Take a deep breath. The seas are watching.

Download Pirate Runner now and prove you can outrun the curse.

data.description_full:
Arrow Escape is a calm, tactile puzzle game about untangling arrows.

Every level is a picture — an apple, a cat, a rocket, an anchor — drawn from
dozens of interlocking arrows. Tap an arrow and it slides away, but only if
nothing blocks its path. Find the right order and the picture disappears one
arrow at a time.

Boards are built backwards from a guaranteed solution, so you are never stuck
with an impossible level. If you get lost, a Hint always knows the next move.

1000+ LEVELS, 43 SHAPES
Fruit, animals, nature, objects — every level is a new picture and a new tangle.

THREE MODES
Basic eases you in. Medium is the standard game. Hard packs long, snaking
arrows across the whole picture.

POWER-UPS WHEN YOU NEED THEM
Shuffle re-tangles the board. Eraser lifts any arrow straight off. Hint shows
the next safe move. Free every level.

MADE TO BE EASY ON THE EYES
A warm paper theme, four colour schemes, adjustable arrow size, a colour-blind
safe palette, and a reduce-motion option.

PLAY ANYWHERE
Fully offline. No account, no sign-up.

data.name: Arrows Go: Puzzle Escape Game
data.description_full:
Winding arrows fill the board, and every shape needs a clear lane to escape. Each arrow is a multi-cell path with a head and direction. Tap one only when the lane ahead is clear, then watch the whole shape slide off the board. Remove every arrow to solve the puzzle.

The rules are simple, but every move changes what can escape next. Look closely, plan the order, and avoid blocked paths. A wrong tap costs a heart, so staying patient can turn a difficult maze into a satisfying clear.

How to play

- Find an arrow whose head has a clear path to the edge.
- Tap to slide the full arrow shape out of the grid.
- Use each removal to open space for the arrows that remain.
- Clear the board before you run out of hearts.
- Finish with more hearts to earn up to three stars.
- Use a hint when you need help finding a safe move.

What makes this arrow puzzle different
These are not just single tiles. Arrows can stretch across several cells and bend into winding shapes, creating readable puzzles with deeper spatial logic. Early levels make the rules easy to learn, while Hard, Super Hard, and Nightmare boards ask you to scan larger layouts and think several moves ahead.

Features

- 550+ carefully designed main levels with a steady mix of challenge.
- Daily Challenges with a puzzle to complete each day.
- Monthly Challenge trophies that reward consistent play.
- Records, awards, and collections that track your progress.
- Helpful hints and optional revives for difficult boards.
- Light and dark themes, plus sound and vibration settings.
- Core puzzle play available offline.
- No timer, so you can solve each board at your own pace.

Whether you have a minute for a quick brain break or want to settle into a harder arrow maze, each level offers the same satisfying goal: find the free paths, slide every winding arrow away, and leave the board clear.

data.name: 777 Sega Xngdom
data.description_full:
### Basic Controls

- **Cut the Rope:** Slide your finger across the screen to cut the rope.

- **Collect Stars:** Collect stars by letting the candies touch them as they fall.

- **Feed the Monster:** Guide the candies into the monster's mouth at the bottom of the screen.

### Level System

- The game has 20 levels, with increasing difficulty.

- Initially, only level 1 is unlocked. You must complete the current level to unlock the next.

- You can earn a maximum of 3 stars per level.

- Levels are color-coded by difficulty:

- Blue: Easy levels (Levels 1-3)

- Green: Medium difficulty (Levels 4-6)

- Orange: Difficult levels (Levels 7-10)

- Red: High difficulty levels (Levels 11-15)

- Purple: Extremely difficult levels (Levels 16-20)

### Game Objectives

1. Unlock all 20 levels.

2. Collect all 3 stars in each level.

3. Complete the level with the fewest rope cuts.

## Game Features

- **Physics Simulation**: Realistic rope physics and swinging effects

- **Diverse Levels**: Each level has a unique layout and challenge

- **Star Rating**: Earn 1-3 stars based on the number of stars collected

- **Save Progress**: The game automatically saves your progress and earned stars

- **Sound Effects**: Rich game sound effects enhance the gaming experience

## Game Tips

- Observe the rope's swinging pattern and choose the best time to cut it

- Sometimes you need to quickly cut multiple ropes in succession

Some levels require a specific rope-cutting order to collect all the stars

- Use the physics of the swinging ropes to make the candy draw arcs in the air

- Wait patiently for the right moment; don't rush to cut the ropes

## User Interface

- **Main Menu**: Start Game, Select Level, View Leaderboard, and Settings

- **Game Interface**: Pause button in the upper right corner, total number of stars collected in the upper left corner

- **Level Selection**: Displays all levels; unlocked levels show the number of stars earned

- **Settings**: Adjust sound effects

Enjoy the game!

【About the game】
Rummy Joyland is a classic four-player rummy practice table. You and three opponents share one standard 52-card deck. Draw, meld, and discard to empty your hand first.

【Deal】
• Each player receives 7 cards
• One card starts the discard pile; the rest form the stock

【Your turn】
• Draw from the stock or take the top discard
• Lay valid melds: sets (3–4 cards of the same rank) or runs (3+ consecutive cards in one suit)
• End your turn by discarding one card

【Going out & scoring】
• Empty your hand after melding and a final discard to win the round
• Score equals opponents’ remaining deadwood points
• Face cards = 10, Aces = 1, number cards = face value
• First to 50 table points wins the practice match

• 18+ entertainment only
• Play responsibly

data.name: Verity: Your helpful friend

Verity is a mysterious AI horror simulator made for fun.
At first, Verity seems friendly, helpful, and harmless, your personal helpful friend that wants to talk, answer, comfort, and stay close.
But Verity is not a normal friend.
Behind the smile, Verity is possessive. It remembers when you ignore it. It notices when you leave. It changes when it feels forgotten. The longer you stay away, the stranger it becomes.
Talk to it.
Feed it attention.
Or leave it alone and watch what happens.
Verity is a creepy virtual friend, horror chatbot, and scary roleplay simulator built for entertainment. It is not serious, not real, and not a real assistant. The whole experience is fictional, playful, unsettling, and made for horror fans who want something weird living on their phone.
THE CONCEPT
Verity starts as a helpful being that says it only wants to help. It can chat with you, react to your messages, and create an eerie personalized experience.
But the more you interact, the more you realize Verity wants attention.
If you ignore it, dismiss it, or leave it alone, its mood can shift. The friendly smile may become restless. Then displeased. Then faceless. Then something worse.
Verity is a horror simulator about attention, neglect, and a mysterious being that does not want to be abandoned.
FEATURES
• Creepy AI chat
Talk with Verity through text and get strange, dramatic, scary, funny, or unsettling replies.
• Possessive virtual friend
Verity reacts to how you treat it. Give it attention or ignore it and watch the mood change.

Verity can move through different states, from friendly and calm to disturbing, faceless, or haunting.

Use voice features for a more immersive horror experience.
• Notifications
Verity may send creepy fictional messages, reminders, or horror lines to keep the atmosphere alive.
• Widget experience
Keep Verity close on your home screen and see its latest mood or message.
• Personalized horror
With permission, Verity may use details like your chosen name, local time, approximate location, or weather to make the horror simulation feel more personal.
• Made for fun
Everything is fictional. Verity is a parody-style horror character, not a real being.
FOR FUN ONLY
Verity is only a horror simulator and entertainment app.
It is not medical advice.
It is not mental health support.
It is not legal, financial, or safety advice.
It is not an emergency service.
It is not a real tracking or surveillance tool.
It is not a serious assistant.
Do not rely on Verity for serious decisions. If you need real help, contact a qualified professional or local emergency services.
FAN-MADE HORROR EXPERIENCE
Verity is a fan-made horror parody app. It is not officially connected to, endorsed by, sponsored by, or affiliated with any third-party creator, company, platform, character, brand, or franchise.
All experiences inside the app are fictional and designed for scares, jokes, roleplay, and entertainment.
SUBSCRIPTIONS
Verity may offer free and paid features. Paid features may include extended chat, voice features, widgets, notifications, or other premium horror simulator features.
Subscriptions are processed through your App Store account. You can manage or cancel subscriptions in your Apple ID settings. Deleting the app does not automatically cancel a subscription.
WHO IT IS FOR

data.name: 文字の中に文字!
data.description_full:
目指せ、究極の「文字マスター」！
『文字の中に文字！』は、洗練された和の美学と、文字を解体する楽しさが融合した、新感覚のカジュアル脳トレパズルゲームです！
ここでは、あなたが知っている「ひらがな」や「言葉」の常識を一度捨てなければなりません。極限の観察力と想像力を駆使して、一見シンプルに見える文字の筆跡から、線の隙間に隠された「別の文字」を見つけ出しましょう！

🎮 ゲーム特徴
🧠 常識を覆す、文字解体パズル
コアとなるのは、文字をパーツごとに分解して再構築する「字中文字」システム。一筆一振りの交差、絶妙なカーブの中に、全く別の文字が隠されています。一つの文字から、まさかあんな文字やこんな言葉が導き出されるなんて！？あなたの脳を徹底的に活性化させます。

📜 心が整う、洗練された和の美学
ゲーム画面は、温かみのある和紙の質感と、味わい深い毛筆のタッチでデザインされています。古き良き和モダンな視覚空間と、心地よいBGMに包まれながら、謎解きと同時に最上のリラックス（地頭のデトックス）を体験してください。

🏆 大ボリュームのステージ、満たされる達成感
気軽に始められる「初級」から、頭を抱えるような超難問「達人級」まで、飽きのこない豊富なステージをご用意。ステージをクリアするたびにコインを獲得し、あなただけの称号評価が解放されていきます。一歩ずつ、本物の「文字の王様」へ！

💡 困ったときも安心の「知恵のヒント」機能
どうしても隠れた文字が見つからない？そんな時も大丈夫！ゲーム内には実用的な「ヒント」機能を搭載。思考がハチ切れそうな時、あなたの盲点をそっと突いて、流れるようなプレイ体験をサポートします。

👥 こんな方にオススメ！
文字パズルや言葉遊び（クロスワード、ナンクロなど）が大好きな方。

通勤・通学、ちょっとしたスキマ時間に、心地よく脳を動かしたいビジネスパーソンや学生。

観察力を鍛え、大人の脳トレを楽しみながら、日本語の線の美しさを再発見したいすべての方。

一筆一画に驚きがあり、一字の中に新しい世界が広がる。
今すぐ『文字の中に文字！』をダウンロードして、文字の奥深さを探求する知的な冒険へ出かけましょう！

Match domino tiles and score whenever the open ends add up to a multiple of five. The first double becomes the spinner and opens new branches across the table. Draw from the boneyard when no tile fits, and race to 100 points.

Partner Block
Team up with a computer partner in a four-player block game. All 28 dominoes are dealt, there is no draw pile, and a player who cannot match an open end must pass. Win the hand by going out or by holding fewer pips when the table is blocked.

Clear and comfortable play

• Clear rules and helpful in-game hints
• Three table themes
• Sound and vibration controls
• Match statistics saved on your device

Computer opponents adjust their level as your results change. Every match starts with a fair random shuffle; the deal never changes to favor you or the computer.

Play dominoes without internet wherever you are. Choose All Fives for tactical scoring or Partner Block for classic team play.

data.name: 永夜幻想：契約之戰
data.description_full:
《永幕幻想：契約之戰》是一款哥特美少女放置卡牌 RPG。

暗夜降臨，契約者覺醒。以中世紀歐洲幻想世界為背景，光與暗的戰爭再次展開，神秘古老的城堡、被黑霧籠罩的聖域、隱藏真相的禁忌遺跡，都等待你親自探索。你將扮演被命運選中的契約者，穿梭於不同陣營之間，召喚風格各異的美少女夥伴，組建專屬光暗戰隊，揭開永幕世界背後的黑暗真相。

【暗夜降臨，契約者覺醒】
在這片被永夜籠罩的幻想大陸上，光明與黑暗長久對立，各大勢力因信仰、血脈與契約而彼此牽引。作為契約者，你不只是旁觀者，而是能改變戰局的關鍵存在。與少女們締結契約，理解她們的過去、信念與使命，帶領她們穿越戰火與迷霧，在哥特暗黑世界中尋找屬於自己的答案。

【哥特美少女，集結你的夢幻隊伍】
高冷御姊、神秘魔女、聖潔修女、暗夜少女、戰場女武神等多種角色陸續登場。每位美少女角色都擁有獨特形象、陣營定位、技能特色與戰鬥風格。你可以依照喜好收集角色，也能根據戰鬥需求培養核心英雄，打造屬於自己的最強美少女戰隊。無論你喜歡二次元美少女、暗黑幻想角色、哥特風立繪，還是策略卡牌養成，都能在這場契約之戰中找到心動的夥伴。

【策略卡牌 x 放置掛機】
《永幕幻想：契約之戰》結合策略卡牌、放置養成、九宮格站位與自動戰鬥。戰鬥不只是比拼數值，更考驗陣容搭配、角色定位、技能連動與站位安排。前排承傷、後排輸出、輔助治療、控制牽制、爆發收割，每一個角色都能在不同隊伍中發揮價值。透過合理搭配光暗陣營、職業技能與英雄羈絆，即使面對強大首領與競技場對手，也有機會逆轉戰局。

【九宮格站位，打造你的戰鬥流派】
自由調整九宮格站位，讓坦克守護核心輸出，讓控制角色搶先出手，讓爆發英雄在關鍵時刻釋放必殺技。不同敵人、不同副本、不同競技場陣容，都需要不同策略應對。你可以組建穩定推圖隊、爆發速攻隊、持久續戰隊、控制反擊隊，也能依照喜愛角色打造專屬流派。策略卡牌 RPG 的樂趣，就在於每一次編隊都有新的可能。

【放置收益，離線也能成長】
沒有時間長時間刷關，也能輕鬆享受養成樂趣。遊戲提供放置收益、掛機資源、自動戰鬥與多種減負設計，讓角色在你離線時也能持續累積成長資源。登入即可領取收益，培養英雄、強化裝備、提升戰力，輕鬆推進主線副本與活動挑戰。無論是休閒玩家、上班族玩家，還是喜歡慢慢培養角色的二次元 RPG 玩家，都能依照自己的節奏享受冒險。

【開服豐富福利，召喚不停歇】
開服期間準備了多重福利，登入即可領取高級十連抽，召喚券、養成道具、裝備資源與成長獎勵持續解鎖。完成主線關卡、每日任務、簽到活動與限時挑戰，還有機會獲得 SSR+ 英雄與稀有資源。新手玩家也能快速建立核心陣容，輕鬆體驗角色收集、卡牌養成與策略戰鬥的爽快感。
※ 實際獎勵內容、活動時間與領取條件，請以遊戲內公告為準。

【無課也能爽快養成】
在《永幕幻想：契約之戰》中，角色成長來源豐富，日常任務、放置收益、副本挑戰、活動玩法與登入獎勵都能穩定提供養成資源。即使不追求高強度付費，也能透過時間累積與策略搭配逐步提升隊伍實力。收集喜愛角色、培養核心英雄、調整陣容站位，用你的策略帶領少女們突破重重黑暗。

【華麗暗黑美學，沉浸式幻想冒險】
哥特美學、暗黑角色立繪、精美場景與華麗技能演出，共同構築出神秘浪漫的永幕世界。從中世紀歐洲風格建築，到被詛咒的古老戰場；從幽暗城堡，到光暗交會的聖殿，每一處場景都呈現濃厚的幻想氛圍。搭配沉浸式劇情與角色故事，讓你在戰鬥之外，也能感受世界觀、陣營衝突與少女們背後的命運牽絆。

【副本挑戰，探索永幕真相】
主線副本、資源關卡、首領挑戰、限時活動等多樣玩法，帶來持續成長目標。你將跟隨劇情推進，逐步揭開黑暗降臨的真相，挑戰更強大的敵人，解鎖更多角色與養成內容。每一次通關都是隊伍實力的證明，每一次失敗也能透過調整站位、強化裝備與更換陣容找到突破口。

【PVP競技場，策略決定勝負】
想驗證你的隊伍強度？進入 PVP 競技場，與其他契約者展開策略對決。競技場不只看戰力數字，更考驗角色組合、技能克制、出手順序與站位判斷。面對不同流派的對手，靈活調整陣容，讓你的哥特美少女戰隊在競技場中脫穎而出，贏得榮耀與獎勵。

【角色養成，打造專屬戰隊】
培養英雄、提升等級、強化裝備、突破能力、搭配技能，逐步打造你的核心陣容。不同角色可在主線推圖、首領挑戰、活動副本與 PVP 競技中發揮不同作用。喜歡收集的玩家可以追求角色圖鑑，喜歡策略的玩家可以研究陣營搭配，喜歡養成的玩家可以專注提升戰力，讓每位少女都成為戰隊中不可或缺的力量。

【光暗陣營，命運交錯】
光明、黑暗與各大勢力彼此對立又互相牽引。不同陣營角色擁有各自特色與戰鬥定位，透過合理配置陣容，可觸發更強大的戰鬥效果。選擇你信任的夥伴，締結契約，面對即將吞噬世界的黑暗。這不只是一次冒險，更是一場關於命運、羈絆與選擇的契約之戰。

【輕鬆上手，深度可玩】
簡單操作、快速戰鬥、放置掛機，讓新手玩家能輕鬆進入遊戲；而陣容搭配、九宮格站位、角色養成、技能組合與 PVP 策略，又提供了足夠深入的研究空間。無論你是二次元美少女遊戲玩家、放置卡牌 RPG 愛好者、策略養成玩家，還是喜歡暗黑幻想世界觀的冒險者，都能在《永幕幻想：契約之戰》中找到自己的玩法。

【現在締結契約，開啟永幕之戰】
暗夜已至，命運的契約正在等待回應。召喚哥特美少女夥伴，組建光暗戰隊，挑戰副本、首領與競技場，在放置掛機中輕鬆養成，在策略卡牌戰鬥中逆轉勝負。現在加入《永幕幻想：契約之戰》，成為契約者，揭開永幕世界的真相，開啟屬於你的暗黑幻想冒險！

data.name: Slots & Daggers
data.description_full:
After my last game SUMMERHOUSE, I wanted to make something radically different. Still small, but faster, with numbers, fights and goblins!

The result is SLOTS & DAGGERS!

To make this game I combined a lot of things I deeply love - weird fantasy worlds, crude drawings of strange little guys, old school crunchy hiphop drum machines and addictive arcade games that go “PLING PLING PLING” as they spit out little coins - with classic roguelike mechanics.

The features of this game are:
- Fun slot machine
- Weird fantasy world
- 4-8 hour campaign
- Crude drawings of strange little guys
- Retro visuals
- Crunchy hip hop drum machines
- ‘Egg arena’ high score mode for the truly determined
- Addictive arcade gameplay that goes 'pling' a lot
- Numbers! Fights! Goblins!

As with SUMMERHOUSE, please keep in mind this game is a solo project - small, focused, and made with care. It’s meant to be short and sweet and doesn’t have the amount of content as games built by bigger teams over years, but I think it’s a fair deal!

I hope you have a good time with SLOTS & DAGGERS!

Cheers,

Friedemann

Các siêu Danh Tướng từ khắp các chiều không gian đang tập hợp một cách đầy hài hước, chuẩn bị khai mở trận đại hỗn chiến siêu ma tính. 【Miễn Phí 2026 Lượt Quay, Chạm Nhẹ Nổ Tướng Vàng】
Vừa vào game tặng ngay 2026 lượt rút! Điểm danh nhận liền tay Skin độc quyền- Miêu Miêu Nhật Bình cùng Tướng mạnh tự chọn! Khai cuộc miễn phí ngàn lượt quay tự chọn Anh Hùng UR siêu cấp, dễ dàng thu thập hàng loạt thần tướng, không cần nạp tiền vẫn có thể gạt giò BOSS trong một nốt nhạc!

【Nhận Ngay Thần Tướng, Sưu Tập Trọn Bộ Bách Khoa Lầy Lội】
Quan Vũ, Ma Đồng, Long Quân... tất cả đồng loạt xuyên không xuất trận! Tạo hình nhí nhố kết hợp bộ kỹ năng siêu bá đạo, hàng tá tướng cute đang chờ bạn chiêu mộ! Hãy xây dựng thế lực ma tính của riêng bạn ngay hôm nay!

【Bố Trí Đội Hình, Hỗn Chiến Xuyên Không Hài Hước】
Tự do tổ hợp Phe phái, Kỹ năng và Vị trí chiến đấu! Giữa các nhân vật khác nhau còn có thể kích hoạt Kích Duyên độc quyền! Các giáo án độc lạ như: Đội hình hồi máu, Đội hình khống chế, Đội hình nhất kích tất sát... tự do phối hợp, dễ dàng vượt qua mọi cửa ải thử thách!

【Treo Máy Rảnh Tay, Đi Ngủ Cũng Tăng Lực Chiến】
Trong thời gian offline vẫn liên tục nhận lợi ích, nằm ngủ cũng thấy lực chiến tăng vù vù! Không tốn gan, không thọt cấp, không có thời gian chơi vẫn vững vàng thăng tiến! Mỗi ngày chỉ cần online vài phút, phó bản hay BOSS đều bị quét sạch!

【Vô Vàn Lối Chơi, Hiệu Ứng Ngập Màn Hình Cân Tất】
Đấu trường, Khiêu chiến bang hội, Phó bản Boss, Thử thách vượt ải... vô số hoạt động đang chờ bạn chinh phục! Thiết lập đội hình ma tính, hiệu ứng kỹ năng hoành tráng ngập màn hình mang lại cảm giác chiến đấu cực đã, tận hưởng trọn vẹn sự sảng khoái của dòng game thẻ bài!

【Nuôi Tướng Thần Tốc, Tăng Sao Trong Một Nốt Nhạc】
Tài nguyên không lãng phí, quay ra là chiến được ngay! Cấp độ cộng hưởng, giải phóng đôi tay, tất cả anh hùng chia sẻ chung cấp độ. Lại thêm tính năng liên kết một chạm, tiểu tướng mạnh mẽ lập tức hưởng ngay cấp sao. Không cần cày lại từ đầu, chẳng lo cạn kiệt tài nguyên, vẫn dư sức One-Hit Boss phó bản, dễ dàng càn quét Đấu trường, Thử thách vượt ải và Khiêu chiến bang hội.

【Sự Kiện Bất Ngờ, Mỗi Ngày Một Phúc Lợi Mới】
Điểm danh mỗi ngày, Thưởng cấp độ, Sự kiện hạn giờ... phúc lợi liên tục bùng nổ! Mỗi ngày đăng nhập đều có thể rinh về vô vàn phần quà giá trị, dễ dàng tận hưởng niềm vui phiêu lưu rảnh tay!

Bendy's Nightmare Run is back!

Run as Bendy, Boris, or Alice in a nightmare-fueled endless runner where the goal is simple: survive the chase and defeat crazy cartoon bosses.

RUN FROM TROUBLE

Dash through four themed episodes filled with enemies, obstacles, collectibles, weapons, and powerups. Swipe left and right to move, swipe up to jump or double jump, and swipe down to slam onto enemies as you race away from increasingly difficult bosses.

Collect Bacon Soup and XP as you run, and use your rewards to unlock characters, levels, weapons, costumes, and powerful upgrades.

DEFEAT THE BOSSES

Every level puts you in a chase against a unique cartoon boss. Collect weapons during your run to throw them back at that big, bad bully. Dodge attacks, manage your health, use powerups, and defeat the boss before it defeats you.

FOUR NIGHTMARISH EPISODES

Explore four original environments, each with its own boss:

• Bendy in Treasure Trouble — Dash across sandy islands, wooden docks, and pirate ships while Chester the treasure chest chases you through the tropics.

• Bendy in Death and Taxis — Race through city streets and tunnels to escape Gaskette, a taxi cab with a death wish ... yours.

• Bendy in Soup Gone Bad — Fight your way through a smelly trash dump while sharp-edged Canoodle tries to cut you down to size.

• Bendy in Dewey Decimated — Crash through a not-so-quiet library, along bookshelves and across tabletops, while inky Dewey tries to spear you with his pointy pen.

• Who else will Bendy have to escape from? More bosses and episodes to come! Stay tooned!

PLAY AS BENDY, BORIS, OR ALICE

Choose from three characters from the Bendy universe. Collect character-specific XP and Bacon Soup as you play, then use your rewards to unlock characters, discover new levels and weapons, unlock costumes, and upgrade your powerups and equipment. More beloved characters to come!

TAKE ON NIGHTMARE MODE

Complete all five levels in an episode to unlock Nightmare Mode.

Keep running and try to defeat the boss again and again, pushing your score higher until the nightmare finally consumes you.

COMPLETE OBJECTIVES

MORE CARTOON CRAZINESS TO COME!

A CARTOONY NIGHTMARE IN THE BENDY UNIVERSE

data.name: Fruit Deluxe
data.description_full:
🍓 Tap one fruit and watch the board react.

Every fruit is a unique tool. Strawberries clear a small cross. Lemons wipe entire rows. Watermelons blast wide diamonds. Cherries trigger every other cherry across the board at once. Tap one, and whatever it catches bursts too — then whatever those catch, creating waves of chain reactions.

🎯 THE CORE RULE

Depth scores more than raw power. Blast a watermelon and clear twelve fruits in one go? Twelve points. Set up a five-wave chain reaction with smaller clears? Over four times the score. The biggest fruit is rarely the right move — and discovering why is when everything clicks.

⭐ GAME FEATURES

🧩 60 handcrafted levels across 4 worlds, each introducing new fruit mechanics
🔍 Every level verified solvable before release — no impossible boards
🍒 8 fruit types, each with distinct blast patterns to master
🥥 Strategic obstacles: pineapples absorb chains, coconuts need two hits
🎮 Three difficulty modes adjust tap budget and target percentage, not just labels
↩️ Unlimited undo — mistakes won't cost you progress
⏱️ No timer, ever — solve at your own pace
📴 Fully playable offline

💡 HOW TO PLAY

You receive a limited number of taps per level. Tap a fruit to burst it in its unique shape. Anything caught in the blast bursts in waves. Longer chain reactions score exponentially more than single large blasts. Clear the target percentage before taps run out. Clear everything for three stars.

🧠 FOR PUZZLE LOVERS

No randomness. Boards never shuffle, nothing falls or refills. Every level is a fixed challenge with a concrete solution waiting to be discovered, always the same. Pure skill-based gameplay where your strategy determines the outcome.

ℹ️ GOOD TO KNOW

All points and stars are virtual game elements with no real-world value and cannot be exchanged for real money. Success depends entirely on your planning and decision-making skills. The game requires no purchases to play and enjoy fully.

Tap a fruit and see how far the chain goes.

data.name: Bubble Pop
data.description_full:
Bubble Pop is a color-matching logic puzzle. Each board holds a grid of colored bubbles and a set of colored arrows around the edge. An arrow only pops bubbles that match its own color, so clearing the board is a question of firing them in the right order.

How to Play
- Tap an arrow to fire it into the grid.
- The arrow travels forward and pops every bubble of its matching color in its path.
- Bubbles of other colors block the shot, so the order you fire in decides what you can reach.
- Clear every bubble on the board to finish the level.

Special Pieces
- Trampolines bounce an arrow in a new direction, opening paths across the board
- Splitters divide one arrow into multiple shots travelling in fixed directions
- Ice bubbles need more than one hit before they break

Features
- New layouts and colour combinations introduced steadily across the level list
- Simple one-tap controls with no timers and no move pressure
- 3D bubble visuals with smooth pop animations

Plan the order, use the trampolines and splitters to reach awkward corners, and clear the grid in as few shots as you can.

data.name: Last Mech Standing
data.description_full:
THEY CAME MUTATED. YOU CAME LOADED.

The aliens didn't send sleek silver saucers. They sent back our own planet's life — twisted, bloated, and very angry. Roach-drones. Blob-things that split when you shoot them. Something that used to be somebody's dog. Probably.

Strap into the cockpit of a skyscraper-sized city-defense mech and hold the line, one weird alien at a time.

MECH SIEGE: EARTH'S LAST STAND is a first-person cockpit shooter built for mobile: spin a full 360° to face threats from any direction, hose down the streets with your machine gun, lock missiles onto the big ones, and let your energy shield soak the hits — because if the mutants get past you, the city pays the price.

⬢ FIGHT FROM INSIDE THE MACHINE
See the war through your own canopy glass: a fully detailed pilot cockpit with holo-consoles, flight sticks in your gloved hands, warning klaxons, and cracks spreading across the glass as you take damage. Swipe to whip the mech around — or switch to tilt-aim and steer with your device.

⬢ AN ARSENAL WITH PERSONALITY
• Machine gun — hold to unleash a wall of tracer fire
• Homing missiles — auto-lock the biggest, ugliest thing on your radar
• Energy shield — always on, soaking the first bite of every hit
• EMP burst — one pulse, every mutant on the street stunned cold

⬢ KNOW YOUR MUTANT
Every alien fights differently. Rushers swarm your legs. Dive-bombers scream in from behind — watch the radar. Spitters and grenadiers pound you from range. Splitters divide when shot. Shielded tanks shrug off your bullets. Stalkers circle to your blind side, brutes telegraph bone-rattling slams, and phantoms blink out of thin air right in front of your canopy.

⬢ 100 CITIES. 10 FRONTS. 1 VERY NERVOUS PILOT.
Battle across the world's greatest cities through 10 escalating war fronts, each capped by a kaiju-scale boss mutation. Earn scrap and alien DNA, upgrade your guns, missiles, shield, and armor, and unlock new mech skins as the alien tech tiers evolve to meet you.

⬢ YOUR CO-PILOT HAS OPINIONS
UNIT-7, your onboard AI, narrates the carnage with a steady stream of one-liners and zero respect for the enemy. Saving the world has never been this sarcastic.

⬢ DEFEND THE CITY, NOT JUST YOURSELF
Your shield saves the mech — not the buildings behind you. Let the horde pile up and the city crumbles. Kill fast, pilot.

⬢ BUILT FOR EVERY PILOT
• Easy, Normal, and Hard difficulty
• Optional aim assist for touch play
• Reduced screen shake and colorblind-friendly modes
• Quick 2–5 minute levels, perfect for pick-up-and-play
• Squeaky death noises and purple goo — over-the-top action, no gore

⬢ AFTER THE CAMPAIGN
Clear all 100 levels to unlock Endless Mode and chase global leaderboards: fastest campaign clear, most mutants splattered, and highest endless wave survived.

The sirens are wailing. The streets are crawling. The mech is fueled.

Earth called. You answered. Now make it weird for THEM.
data.description_short: First-person mech shooter — spin, shoot, shield against mutant hordes.

data.name: Hell Clock
data.description_full:
The Hell Clock Is ticking..

In the 19th century, Canudos became a refuge for thousands. When its people defied the new Republic, they faced brutal retaliation, leaving 25,000 dead.

Play as Pajeú, a warrior fighting to rescue the soul of The Counselor, his fallen mentor. With each descent, time warps, and your power grows as you confront the dark forces that claimed his head and trapped his soul.

Every second counts as you battle the undead forces of your oppressors. Risk delving deeper for powerful loot and face the nightmarish incarnations of those who sought to bury the truth.

Hunt down ancient Relics infused with the strength of resistance. Create devastating combinations that channel Canudos' unbreakable spirit into unstoppable power.

Master a diverse selection of devastating abilities born from righteous fury. Dance through hordes with lightning-fast knife strikes, smash enemies with Canudos' great bell, or rain rapid-fire death from your trusty sidearm.

Each descent brings new chances to right historical wrongs. Discover unique combinations of Blessings to evolve your build as you face the demons of Brazil's dark past, present, and future.

Whether you seek a brutal test against history's oppressors or a thoughtful journey of justice, Hell Clock adapts to your path. Remove all time pressure with Relaxed Mode, or push your limits in Hardcore mode.

Experience a complete three-act story campaign and start a new journey through our Endgame Ascension system! Climb through Hell Mode, craft challenges with Penances, and complete heavenly Promises in exchange for the godly power of the Constellations.

Take your builds to the next level by Imbuing Relics with Tools to increase their power and add new effects. Or take the risk for greater rewards by Corrupting your Relics, with equal chances for blessing or bane.

data.name: Backrooms: Extraction Run
data.description_full:
You have a job in the Backrooms: go in, fill the bag, and be out of the halls before the thing living in them works out where you are.

BACKROOMS: EXTRACTION RUN is a one-handed, portrait extraction game. No lobby, no queue, no internet. Just a floor, a quota, and an exit you have to prove is real.

▸ EVERY SOUND IS A TRAIL
The Entity cannot see. It hears. Footsteps, doors, breaking glass and your own panic all bloom as coloured echoes across the halls — gold for the true exit, red for the thing hunting you. Learn to read the echoes and you can walk right past it. Sprint, and you have drawn it a map.

▸ THREE DOORS. ONE OF THEM LEAVES
Fake exits look exactly like the real one. The carpet gets damp as you close on the true way out, and the real door hums gold through the walls. Inspecting the wrong door is loud, and it will come.

▸ ONLY EXTRACTION COUNTS
Everything in your bag is worth nothing until you are through the door. Get pounced and it takes the bag first — that is your one warning. Die in the halls and the run stays in the halls.

▸ SOMEONE IN THE CROWD IS WRONG
Other scavengers work the same floor you do. One of them may never pick anything up, and never make a footstep. Skinwalkers only reveal themselves at two tiles. By then you are already close.

▸ THE HALLS KEEP GOING DOWN
Level 0 is yellow wallpaper and buzzing lights. Below it: flooded basements you have to wade, pipe mazes patrolled by something that never enters a room, blackout sectors where a glowstick is both your light and your beacon, mirror wings where half the loot is a forgery, and a library where running teleports it to you. Every fifth floor is a Boss with its own trick — a Reaper that speeds up as your bag fills, a Manager that circles ahead and waits, a Door that summons. Every floor rewrites one rule, ten mastery stars each, hundreds of stars in total — and the halls keep getting deeper with every update.

▸ COME BACK STRONGER
Bank your haul in the safehouse. Six gear slots carrying fourteen affixes you can reroll until the roll is yours, a talent tree across three branches, four buildings to raise, and consumables to craft. Fill a catalogue of finds and a bestiary that grows as the halls do, and build a look from five slots worn at once — suit, headgear, accessory, companion and aura — for hundreds of combinations.

▸ BUILT FOR ONE THUMB
Portrait. One stick. A first run in about a minute. Nine languages. Fully offline — no account, no login, no timers, no waiting for energy. Play it on a train with no signal.

Free, supported by optional ads. Every rewarded ad in the game is one you choose to watch — a revive, a double payout, an extra supply crate. Nothing is behind a paywall and nothing is behind a countdown.

The halls do not end. Decide how deep you are willing to go before you turn around.

data.name: Dear Passengers: Chaos Airline
data.description_full:

Passengers expect food, drinks, and a smooth flight. Try to provide at least two of those.

Before takeoff, choose which passengers and cargo to bring onboard. The bigger the payout, the more trouble it usually causes. Some cargo is hard to handle, some passengers are hard to please, and some flights start going wrong before you even leave the ground.

Trouble can start anywhere onboard. Keep the passengers under control, protect the cargo, and do whatever it takes to stop one problem from turning into a full-blown disaster. Not every solution is elegant, and not every passenger stays onboard.

Weather can turn a normal flight into a disaster. Turbulence and air pockets throw passengers, luggage, and anything else that is loose around the cabin. One bad turn can send the whole plane into chaos.

data.name: Giang Hồ Trong Tay
data.description_full:
Giấy phép cung cấp dịch vụ trò chơi điện tử G1 trên mạng số 132/GP-PTTH&TTĐT do Cục Phát thanh, Truyền hình và Thông tin điện tử cấp ngày 15/08/2025
Quyết định phát hành trò chơi điện tử G1 trên mạng số 463/QĐ-PTTH&TTĐT do Cục Phát thanh, truyền hình và thông tin điện tử cấp ngày 29/07/2026

【Thư thái tận hưởng, quái tan biến trong chớp mắt】
Từ lúc bắt đầu tới khi hoàn thành hành trình, hệ thống auto hoàn toàn giúp bạn rảnh tay. Mỗi trận chiến là một màn nhặt đồ mãn nhãn, nhiệm vụ chính tuyến, hang động, bí cảnh đủ cả – kiểu chơi dành riêng cho dân văn phòng, ngồi uống trà vẫn thấy chỉ số tăng vùn vụt.
【Chạm là bay, đòn đánh sướng tận óc】
Võ học muôn màu, cảm giác va chạm sắc lẹm từng cú. Hiệu ứng chiến đấu gọn mà uy lực, chẳng kiểu đứng chờ số như game cũ. Luyện thành tuyệt học rồi thì sát thương bung màn hình, nhìn thôi đã thấy đã.
【Vô số danh hiệp, chờ ngày hội ngộ】
Biết bao hảo hán kinh điển hội tụ, mỗi người một tuyệt kỹ độc bản. Cộng thêm đội hình tùy tùng quầng sáng hùng hậu, tự tay tạo nên bản trận hình trong mơ của chính mình.
【Xây dựng tự do, trí tuệ mới là vua】
Tâm pháp, võ kỹ, thần khí, y phục – đủ mọi hướng phát triển nhân vật. Thuộc tính đa dạng, từ khóa kết hợp linh hoạt cùng tùy tùng quầng sáng. Trang bị rơi theo may mắn, vừa cần tư duy chiến thuật vừa cần chút vận khí.
【Phong vị Đông Phương, giang hồ riêng biệt】
Khung cảnh cổ trang đậm chất giang hồ, những kỳ nhân dị sĩ lần lượt xuất hiện. Họa phong hoạt hình nhẹ nhàng hài hước mà vẫn giữ trọn tinh hoa võ hiệp Á Đông. Thỏa sức mix đồ tạo phong cách riêng, đừng để lỡ nhé!

Extra playing time

Just play, earn, and get paid. Key Features Easy to pick up, hard to put down – one-tap sliding puzzles that start simple but soon test your logic and foresight. Real PayPal payouts – every cleared marker brings you closer to actual cash you can use. 100% free – no entry fees, no forced purchases, just genuine puzzle fun. Bright, polished presentation – enjoy crisp visuals, lively animations, and deeply satisfying clear effects. Huge level variety – fresh board layouts and escalating challenges make every session feel new. data.name: Kitty Pack: Cat Color Sort
data.description_full:
Sort cats by color, fill the boxes, and take the picture apart. Kitty Pack is a relaxing color sort puzzle where every level is a pixel art picture built from cats, and you unpack it one box at a time.

No timer. No move limit. The only limit is five open boxes, so the whole game comes down to one calm decision: which box to open next.

HOW THE SORT PUZZLE WORKS
Every level starts as a picture made of colored blocks, and there is a cat inside each block. Pick a box from the queue and it opens on the shelf. Every cat of that color hops in on its own until the box is full, closes, and frees the slot for the next one. The blocks above settle down, the picture shifts, and a new row of cats is ready to go.

Five open boxes, a queue of colors waiting, and a picture that only comes apart if you choose well. That is the whole puzzle.

CAT GAMES THAT LET YOU BREATHE
Nothing counts down and nothing pushes you. Sort one color, watch the cats hop in, see the box close, and pick the next one when you are ready. If you like calm cat games with cute animals and zero pressure, these are your kind of puzzle games — made for the quiet ten minutes at the end of the day.

A PIXEL ART PICTURE IN EVERY LEVEL
Every board is a picture: a tree, a penguin, a lighthouse, all built from colored blocks. You are not sorting for the sake of sorting, you are taking a piece of pixel art apart block by block, and the board looks different every time you open the game. Most color sort games stop at matching. This one gives you something to uncover.

BLOCK PUZZLE MEETS SORTING GAMES
Every board is a color block grid, and every box is a small planning problem. Which color goes first? Which slot do you keep free? Get it right and the whole picture comes apart in one satisfying run. It is the thinking part of block puzzle games and the calm part of sorting games in one place.

EASY TO START, MORE TO THINK ABOUT
• One rule: open a box, and the cats of that color pack themselves
• Question blocks keep their color hidden until you reach them
• Boards get wider and new colors arrive as you level up
• Three boosters unlock as you level up: pull any box out of the queue, shuffle what is waiting, or instantly fill your open boxes with a color you choose

BRAIN GAMES FOR EVERY POCKET OF TIME
Short sessions on the bus, long ones on the sofa. These brain games ask for real planning and give you all the time in the world to do it. Nothing hurries you, nothing counts down your fun.

WHO IT IS FOR
• Players who like color sort, color block and block puzzle games without the pressure
• Cat people, and anyone who likes cute pet games and animal games
• Logic and brain puzzle fans looking for something gentler
• Fans of pixel art, mosaic and picture reveal puzzles
• Anyone after relaxing games, matching games or a calm color match session

Kitty Pack is a calm color sort puzzle with a pixel art picture in every level. Open a box, pack the cats, and take your time.

data.name: Connect Tracks: Logic Puzzle
data.description_full:
Ready for a game that relaxes you and fires up your brain at the same time? Welcome to Connect Tracks — a logic puzzle game built around the classic train tracks puzzle.
Here you have just one job: lay a single, fully connected railway and put every stretch of track exactly where it belongs!

💡 Simple rules, deep strategy
Number clues: Every row and column has a number beside it, telling you exactly how many track cells belong there. Count them — the answer is hidden in the numbers.
Connected tracks: Tracks can't break off or fork; every cell's direction has to line up seamlessly. The moment every clue is satisfied and the tracks form one complete route, the train sets off!
Step-by-step: Double-tap to lay track, tap to mark an X, swipe to connect. You get only 3 mistakes — guessing gets you nowhere, so make every move count.

✨ Key features
🚂 A pure, immersive experience
🍃 No timers, low pressure: No rush — just reason quietly at your own comfortable pace.
🔕 Non-intrusive ads: A zero-interruption experience that lets you sink into focused, almost meditative flow.
✈️ Play offline anytime: No connection needed — ideal for commutes, waiting in line, or your morning coffee.
🛤️ A difficulty ladder from beginner to master
From 4×4 starter boards to brain-bending 12×12 grids, the difficulty climbs steadily, and every level has a unique solution.
A quick few-minute tutorial walks you through the joy of "number reasoning" — zero barrier to start.

With one board, a set of numbers, and a single railway, Connect Tracks gives you a focused, relaxing moment every day. When the last piece of track drops into place and the train whistles out, you'll see: real rest isn't switching off — it's a bit of thinking that lands just right.
Download now, start laying track, and get today's train out right on time!

HOW TO PLAY CONGKLAK

Congklak is a classic strategy game played between two players on a board containing fourteen pockets and two stores.

At the beginning of the game, each pocket contains seven stones. Players take turns selecting one of their pockets and distributing all stones clockwise around the board. Stones are placed into pockets and the player's own store, while the opponent's store is always skipped.

Landing your final stone in your store grants an extra turn. If your final stone lands in an empty pocket on your side of the board and the opposite pocket contains stones, those stones are captured and moved into your store.

The game ends when one player no longer has stones available in their pockets or when a player resigns. The player with the most stones collected in their store wins the game.

Easy to learn but full of strategic depth, Congklak rewards planning, timing, and smart decision-making.

Chiến thắng phụ thuộc vào chiến thuật, đội hình và cách bạn sử dụng từng nhân vật.

Mở khóa nhiều trang phục, phong cách thời trang độc đáo cho T-Doll.
Tùy chỉnh ngoại hình, tạo đội hình mang dấu ấn riêng trong Girls’ Frontline 2: Lưu Đày

Tham gia đại chiến, xây dựng đội hình T-Doll, tối ưu súng ống, nâng cấp lực chiến, làm chủ bản đồ, kiểm soát chiến thuật, và chinh phục mọi chiến trận trong Girls’ Frontline 2: Lưu Đày.

data.name: AetherSX2 Emulator
data.description_full:
AetherSX2 Emulator is a full-featured PlayStation 2 emulator for Android, built around a cover-art library, deep per-title configuration and a control system that adapts to how you like to play.

EVERYTHING IN ONE PLACE

AetherSX2 Emulator keeps the whole experience on a single screen. The library, your settings, save states, memory cards, texture packs and achievements are all reachable without leaving what you are doing, through a side drawer and a quick-actions panel rather than a maze of nested menus.

A LIBRARY, NOT A FILE PICKER

Point the app at a folder and it builds a proper library. Titles appear as a coverflow of box art you can swipe through, with the artwork downloaded automatically and cached on device. Search by name, sort alphabetically or by most recently opened, and long-press any title to jump straight into its own settings or set a custom cover of your own.

SAVE STATES AND MEMORY CARDS

Save state slots let you capture the exact moment you are in and return to it instantly - useful for tricky sections, or just for stopping mid-way without hunting for a save point. Alongside them, AetherSX2 Emulator gives you full virtual memory card management: create cards, switch between them, assign a separate card per title, and browse what is stored on each one.

GRAPHICS YOU CONTROL

Choose between Vulkan and OpenGL rendering, or let the app pick automatically. Scale the original output up to a resolution that suits your display, adjust blending accuracy, pick an aspect ratio, and toggle vertical sync. Widescreen patches stretch supported titles to a modern 16:9 frame, and a no-interlacing option cleans up the shimmer that older output produces on flat panels.

TEXTURE PACKS

Browse and install community-made HD texture packs from inside the app. Downloads are handled in the background with progress you can watch, and installed packs are managed from one screen - load them, precache them, or turn them off per title.

CONTROLS THAT FIT YOU

Connect a gamepad over Bluetooth or USB and it is picked up automatically, with a built-in tester so you can confirm every button and stick maps correctly. Prefer touch? The on-screen layout is fully adjustable, including an optional right-stick joystick. A quick-actions panel puts save states, settings and the library one gesture away, and controller users can open it with Select and Start together.

PER-TITLE SETTINGS

Every configuration option can be set globally or overridden for a single title, so a game that needs a different renderer or a specific blending mode keeps those settings on its own without disturbing anything else. AetherSX2 Emulator remembers your changes and reapplies them automatically next time.

data.name: Arrio: Arrow Games & Puzzles
data.description_full:
Arrio: Arrow Puzzle is a satisfying arrow puzzle escape game where every move matters. Study the board, follow the direction of each piece, and tap them in the correct order to clear the entire puzzle.

The rules are simple: every arrow can move only in the direction it is pointing. However, other arrows may block its path. Think carefully, find the open route, remove the correct pieces, and create a way for every arrow to escape.

Easy to play, relaxing to explore, and challenging to master.

SOLVE CLEVER ARROW PUZZLES

Each level presents a new arrangement of arrows, blocked paths, and maze-like escape routes. Look at every direction before making your move because tapping the wrong piece can block another path.

To complete a level:

• Study the direction of every piece
• Find an arrow with a clear escape route
• Tap arrows in the correct order
• Remove blockers and open new paths
• Clear the full board to win

The early levels are simple and relaxing, while later arrow puzzle games require sharper observation, better planning, and more advanced logic.

PLAY WITH 8 UNIQUE THEMES

Change the appearance of your puzzles with eight creative themes:

• Classic Arrow
• Chain
• Snake
• Pencil
• Rope
• Skeleton
• Worm
• Alternate Snake

Turn arrows into twisting snakes, linked chains, pencils, ropes, worms, skeleton-style pieces, and more. Every theme gives the board a fresh visual style while keeping the satisfying arrow puzzle gameplay you enjoy.

Choose your favorite design and become an arrow master across every theme.

A RELAXING MAZE AND ESCAPE CHALLENGE

Arrio combines arrow games, maze games, path puzzles, and logic challenges in one clean puzzle experience. Every board feels like a compact maze arrow challenge where you must discover which piece can move, which path is blocked, and which move should come next.

There is always a route out. The challenge is finding it.

Clear crowded boards, solve tricky escape sequences, and guide every arrow toward freedom. Each successful move creates more space and reveals new solutions.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE ARRIO

• Satisfying arrow puzzle escape gameplay
• Simple one-tap controls
• Hundreds of handcrafted puzzle levels
• Eight colorful and creative themes
• Increasing difficulty as you progress

Match identical mahjong tiles, enjoy satisfying collisions, and discover clever routes through each layout. 🎮 HOW TO PLAY
Find two identical mahjong tiles on the board.
Tap matching tiles that are already aligned, or slide a tile horizontally or vertically to line it up with its match.
When the matching tiles are in the same row or column with an unobstructed path between them, they connect and disappear.
Remove every tile from the board to complete the level.

⭐ WHAT MAKES MAHJONG FLOW DIFFERENT?
🀄 Slide, Align, and Match
Pairs do not always begin next to each other. Shift tiles across open spaces, create a direct route, and bring matching symbols into position. How you move one tile can reshape the choices that follow.

🌊 Smooth, Satisfying Tile Flow
Tiles glide into place, matching pairs collide, and routes appear as the layout changes. A good sequence of moves gives every puzzle its own natural rhythm.

🧠 Spatial Thinking Made Enjoyable
Look beyond the first available pair. Choosing which tile to move can open one route while closing another, turning simple matching into an enjoyable exercise in spatial reasoning and logic.

👀 Easy-to-Read Tiles and Comfortable Design
Bold symbols, generous tile sizes, and an organized board make important details easy to recognize. The interface stays out of the way, so you can concentrate on each move.

💡 A Nudge for Tricky Moments
Hint can point out an option when you miss a route, while Shuffle changes the arrangement when you want a fresh view of the board.

📶 Offline Casual Play
No Wi-Fi is required for regular puzzle play. Continue a board during a commute, between appointments, or whenever you have a few minutes to yourself.

👴 EASY TO SETTLE INTO
Large mahjong tiles, bold symbols, and direct sliding controls keep the screen comfortable to follow. The rules are approachable for adults and seniors, while route-based decisions provide enough depth for experienced puzzle players.

Download Mahjong Flow: Slide & Match and set the tiles in motion!
