data.name: Destroy Shot
data.description_full:
Welcome to Destroy Shot. The cannon is your instrument, the arena your canvas, and every shot paints a picture of pure, unrelenting chaos. This isn't a game about careful nudges and gentle taps. This is about finding the one shot that tears through everything in its path. Every object in the arena — every jar, every crate, every stone fortress — is waiting for its final moment. Your job is simple: aim, fire, and erase it from existence.
What Makes Destroy Shot Special:
- The Art of Absolute Destruction Most games ask you to build or collect. Destroy Shot asks you to unmake. Each level presents a carefully constructed setup, and your job is simple in concept but deeply satisfying in practice: find the critical point and tear it all down. The physics engine ensures that every collision, every shatter, every collapse feels weighty and real. When you pull the trigger, the world responds with the full force of simulated destruction. There's nothing quite like watching a fortress crumble under the force of your single, perfectly aimed shot.
- Where Destruction Meets Celebration The arena is a festival turned spectacle. Colorful bunting stretches across crumbling walls. Lanterns sway as shockwaves ripple through the scene. The chaos is framed by celebration, making every explosion feel like a firework and every collapse feel like confetti falling. This is not violence for its own sake — it is destruction as theater, as performance, as the ultimate show.
- Precision That Rewards Mastery The controls are simple: aim, adjust power, fire. But mastering them is a journey. Understanding how different materials behave under impact, how objects interact in a chain, and how to read a setup for its critical weakness — this is the skill that separates a good shot from a legendary one. Every level teaches you something new, and every success feels earned.
Destroy Shot is for you if:
• You dream of the single perfect shot that changes everything.
• You find satisfaction in absolute, uncompromising destruction.
• You appreciate physics that feels real and weighty.
• You want a game that rewards precision but celebrates power.
• You believe that one well-placed shot is worth a hundred random ones.
Load the Cannon. Take Aim. Fire. Every level is a new setup waiting to be destroyed. Every shot is a new discovery. The arena is waiting for its grand finale — and you are the only one who can deliver it.

data.name: Forbidden Tales
data.description_full:
Forbidden Tales is a unique stacked match-3 puzzle game that perfectly blends relaxing puzzle-solving fun with immersive cinematic story unlocking gameplay.
Work your way through countless puzzle levels to gradually uncover the dark truths hidden behind a tangled, mysterious conspiracy, and unlock exclusive, in-depth story content step by step. Experience relaxing and comforting puzzle mechanics, fulfilling level-clearing progression, and a rich, immersive emotional journey throughout your gaming adventure.
Refined Classic Stacked Match-3 Gameplay
The core gameplay revolves around matching three identical blocks to eliminate multi-layered stacked tiles on the puzzle board. As you advance through the game, level layouts grow increasingly intricate and sophisticated, requiring sharp observation skills and thoughtful strategic planning to clear stages successfully.
Designed with accessibility for all player groups, the game boasts simple and easy-to-grasp basic operations. Meanwhile, every level is crafted with elaborate strategic challenges. Victory relies on your careful analysis of block layouts and pre-planned move strategies, rather than purely fast hand speed and reflexes, bringing thoughtful and rewarding puzzle experiences.
Powerful Strategic Helper Props
Three versatile and practical boosters are available to assist you in overcoming tricky, difficult levels effortlessly and avoiding frustrating gaming moments:
- Undo: Reverse your last move instantly to fix misoperations and adjust your puzzle-solving strategy in time.
- Remove: Directly eliminate any target block on the board to break deadlock situations.
- Shuffle: Rearrange all blocks on the puzzle board to create brand-new matching opportunities.
Skillfully leverage these strategic props to breeze through tough challenging levels and enjoy a smooth puzzle-solving experience all the way.
Immersive Cinematic Story Exploration
Dive into a captivating and enigmatic secret storyline presented via immersive cinematic video clips. Every breakthrough and level progression you make will bring you abundant generous rewards and story surprises:
- Reach designated level milestones to unlock introductory story videos completely for free.
- Keep advancing in the game to unlock full, brand-new story chapters and dig deeper into the core secrets of the plot.
Embark on your thrilling, story-rich puzzle adventure in Forbidden Tales now!

data.name: Save My Dog - Draw Puzzle
data.description_full:
One line. That's all you get.

Save My Dog is a draw puzzle where a Shiba Inu pup needs your help — and the only tool you have is your finger. Each level puts your dog on a platform with a beehive nearby. You draw a single line on the screen. That line becomes a shelter. Bees fly out. If your arc is in the right place, the dog sits calmly inside it. If it isn't, they get through.


HOW IT ACTUALLY WORKS

You're not dragging the dog anywhere. You're building a barrier with your finger.

Each level shows you the layout — where the dog is standing, where the hive sits, what's in between. You figure out the geometry. Then you draw one connected line that blocks the bees before they reach the pup.

The line follows your finger exactly. Short arcs, long sweeps, tight curves — the shape is yours to decide. But the bees don't care about almost. A gap in your line means the whole thing fails.


SPATIAL REASONING, NOT REFLEXES 🧠

This isn't a tap-fast game.

You're solving a geometry problem with your finger. The position, angle, and shape of your line all matter. Draw puzzles and one-stroke puzzle games live or die on whether the mechanic has depth — here, the bee path changes depending on your arc. A line that looks right can still leave a gap you didn't notice.

Players who enjoy brain teasers, physics puzzles, and creative drawing games will feel at home.


WHAT THE GAME DOESN'T HAVE 🔥

No energy system blocking your session. No waiting timers between levels. No heavy interruptions while you're mid-puzzle.

Pick it up, run through a few stages, put it down. Or lock in on one Expert level until you find the perfect line. Both play styles work equally well.


If you've been looking for a draw-to-save puzzle with a dog worth protecting, this is it. Draw the shelter. Keep the bees out.
data.description_short: Your dog. A swarm of bees. One line to stop them. 🐾

data.name: Snack Trek Rush
data.description_full:
Take control of a hungry, glowing snake and slide through a neon arcade grid in Snack Trek Rush! Eat every apple, grow longer with every bite, and dodge the walls, obstacles and your own tail. Each level raises the bar with bigger maps, more apples and trickier mazes - how far can your snake go?

HOW TO PLAY
- Swipe up, down, left or right to steer the snake's head.
- Eat apples to grow longer and rack up points.
- Hit the target apple count shown in the upper-right HUD to clear the level.
- Avoid the outer walls, in-level obstacles and the snake's own tail.
- Cleared a stage? Tap Next Level to take on a harder maze.

KEY FEATURES

Smooth Swipe Controls
Steer with intuitive directional swipes that respond instantly. Glide through tight corners, switch lanes in a flash, and chain quick turns to weave around your tail.

Level-Based Progression
Snack Trek Rush is split into bite-sized stages with clear apple targets. Every cleared level unlocks a fresh layout with more apples to eat, longer snake length and trickier walls and obstacles.

Classic Arcade, Modern Polish
A loving update of the iconic snake formula - glossy cartoon snake, glowing red apples, neon green grid and satisfying eat-and-grow animations. Easy to pick up, hard to put down.

Quick Sessions, Endless Replay
Levels are designed to fit into short breaks. Failed a run? A friendly Retry button gets you back into the action in a single tap.

PRO TIPS
- Plan two moves ahead - the longer your snake grows, the less room you have to maneuver.
- Hug the walls early in a level to leave the center open for the final apples.
- Cut tight U-turns only when there's a clear gap; brushing your tail ends the run.
- Watch the apple counter; the last target apple usually appears in the toughest spot.

WHY PLAYERS ENJOY IT
- A fresh take on a timeless arcade classic.
- Bright, friendly cartoon visuals and crisp neon colors.
- Progressive levels that keep the challenge climbing.
- One-thumb controls perfect for commutes and short breaks.
- Satisfying eat-and-grow loop you can replay forever.

Download Snack Trek Rush now, set your sights on the next apple and slither your way to a brand-new high score!

Tất cả Ác Linh trong truyền thuyết đang phá vỡ chiều không gian, sẵn sàng tông sập cửa phòng bạn bất cứ lúc nào. Việc bạn cần làm là khóa chặt cửa, cùng dàn Anh Hùng khai hỏa trận chiến bảo vệ [Cánh Cửa] cực kỳ phấn khích nhưng cũng đầy kịch tính!

※ Chọn phòng, khóa cửa, nằm yên và thăng cấp!
Ác Linh đến rồi phải làm sao? Không thể chạy thoát? Vậy thì nằm xuống thôi!
Chọn đúng [Căn Phòng] của bạn, khóa chặt [Cánh Cửa], chỉ cần nằm xuống là có thể thăng cấp ngay trong mơ, đồng thời triệu hồi Anh Hùng xây dựng tuyến phòng thủ! Liệu bạn có trụ vững trước tiếng gõ cửa giữa đêm khuya hay không, tất cả phụ thuộc vào cách dàn trận của bạn.

※ Đảo ngược chiến thuật, đấu trí tâm lý
Không cần “đánh cược mạng sống”, cũng không cần trốn chạy! Giường có thể nâng cấp, Cửa có thể nâng cấp và Anh Hùng cũng vậy. Căn phòng chính là pháo đài của bạn. Hãy kết hợp đội hình và chiến thuật chuẩn xác để đối phó với mọi thử thách. Mỗi lần bảo vệ cửa thành công sẽ đem lại cảm giác thỏa mãn tột độ.

※ Trải nghiệm thị giác độc đáo
Phong cách nghệ thuật Gothic Chibi mang đến bầu không khí hắc ám nhẹ nhàng đầy lôi cuốn. Trong ly của ma cà rồng là rượu vang hay là một loại "chất lỏng bí mật" nào khác? Tại sao gã sát thủ cầm cưa máy lại đeo mặt nạ thỏ đáng yêu? Với hàng trăm thiết kế Anh Hùng và Ác Linh riêng biệt, bạn sẽ thấy chúng vừa đáng sợ, lại vừa dễ thương.

※ Hóa thân đa dạng, thách thức mọi bản đồ
Hóa thành thành viên của [Hội Gan Dạ] để thám hiểm những địa danh kỳ bí, từ đoàn tàu đầy Ác Linh, ký túc xá vang vọng tiếng hát đêm, đến hang động ngầm bí ẩn. Người chơi có thể tự do hóa thân thành nhiều nhân vật khác nhau. Hôm nay, bạn sẽ chọn “gương mặt” nào để tham gia vào trò chơi sinh tồn này?

※ Chiến đấu nhanh gọn và kịch tính
Mỗi ván chỉ 5 phút, hoàn toàn không áp lực! Hãy tận hưởng một trận đấu vào những lúc rảnh rỗi. Ngay cả trong thời gian ngắn ngủi, bạn vẫn có thể trải nghiệm game Thủ Thành chất lượng cao một cách dễ dàng nhất.

data.name: Sudoku Detective: Murdoku Case
data.description_full:
Sudoku Detective: Murder Case is a murder mystery Sudoku-style Murdoku logic puzzle game where clues, suspects, and deduction help you find the killer.

Every case is a crime scene. Every clue matters. Place suspects on the logic grid, eliminate impossible cells, and solve the case step by step. This is not ordinary Sudoku, and it is not random guessing. It is a detective puzzle built around reasoning, evidence, and deduction.

If you enjoy Sudoku games, Murdoku puzzles, logic puzzles, murder mystery games, detective games, whodunit cases, crime puzzles, brain teasers, or puzzle games for adults, open your next case file.

SUDOKU LOGIC MEETS DETECTIVE DEDUCTION
In each case, the board becomes your investigation. Instead of filling numbers, you place suspects, victims, and case elements on a grid. Rooms, furniture, blocked cells, objects, and clues create a unique mystery puzzle.

Read each statement carefully. A clue may tell you where a suspect was seen, which room contains an object, who was near the evidence, or which positions are impossible. Combine clues to narrow the board until only one solution remains.

SOLVE MURDER CASES
You are the detective. The suspects are waiting. The victim has been found. The clues are hidden in plain sight.

To solve each murder case, reconstruct the scene using logic. Who could enter the room? Who was beside the evidence? Which suspect could not have been near the victim? Which clue changes everything?

WHY PLAY SUDOKU DETECTIVE?
• Sudoku-style logic with a murder mystery twist
• Detective cases built around clues, suspects, victims, rooms, and evidence
• Logic grid puzzle gameplay for fans of deduction games
• Crime case puzzles that reward careful thinking
• No random guessing required: solve with reasoning
• Brain teaser challenges from easy cases to harder investigations
• Helpful hints when a case gets difficult
• Classic mystery atmosphere with no gore
• A fresh Murdoku puzzle game for Sudoku, whodunit, and detective fans

A NEW KIND OF LOGIC PUZZLE
Sudoku Detective: Murder Case gives every puzzle a purpose. You are not just completing a grid. You are solving a crime.

Some clues are direct. Others only make sense when combined with another statement. Some rooms contain important objects. Some suspects cannot be placed in certain rows, columns, or areas. The best detectives look at every possibility before making an accusation.

This case-based structure makes each level feel like a compact investigation: short enough to play in a break, deep enough to challenge your brain.

FIND THE KILLER
Each mystery asks one question: who is guilty?

Use deduction to place every suspect correctly. Rule out impossible positions. Follow the evidence. Catch contradictions. Complete the logic grid and discover who committed the murder.

If you like classic detective stories, cozy murder mysteries, crime investigation games, Murdoku, Sudoku-style puzzles, logic riddles, and smart brain games, Sudoku Detective is designed for you.

PURE DEDUCTION GAMEPLAY
This is not a hidden object game, an escape room, or a simple number puzzle. Analyze the board, compare clues, and solve each mystery with logic.

TRAIN YOUR DETECTIVE BRAIN
Every case challenges observation, memory, reasoning, and logical thinking. Easy cases teach the rules. Harder cases make you connect clues across suspects, rooms, and board positions.

Use hints only when needed. Improve your deduction skills. Build your case-solving instinct one mystery at a time.

PERFECT FOR FANS OF
Sudoku, Murdoku, logic puzzle games, detective games, murder mystery games, crime case games, deduction puzzles, brain teasers, whodunit stories, mystery case files, logic grid puzzles, and puzzle games for adults.

START YOUR INVESTIGATION
Download Sudoku Detective: Murder Case and solve murder mystery puzzles with Sudoku-style logic.

Read the clues. Place the suspects. Complete the grid. Solve the case. Find the killer
data.description_short: Find the killer with Murdoku-style Sudoku logic, clues, suspects, and deduction!

data.description_full:

(https://giayphep.abei.gov.vn/g1/132076)

Crossfire: Legends, huyền thoại FPS vượt thời gian, cập nhật phiên bản 4.0!
Được phát triển tối ưu cho nền tảng di động, Crossfire: Legends mang đến nhịp độ chiến đấu kịch tính của bản PC huyền thoại — nay với thao tác điều khiển mượt mà, trực quan, sẵn sàng cho mọi cuộc giao tranh mọi lúc, mọi nơi.

C4 Kinh Tế & C4 Kinh Tế Tốc Độ
Đấu trường chiến thuật nơi mỗi quyết định đều ảnh hưởng đến cục diện trận đấu. Quản lý nguồn tiền qua từng vòng, lựa chọn vũ khí và trang bị phù hợp để tối ưu sức mạnh toàn đội. Phối hợp chiến thuật, kiểm soát kinh tế và tận dụng từng cơ hội để lật ngược thế trận, giành chiến thắng trong những màn đối đầu căng thẳng nhất.

Zombie Truy Kích – Di Tích Trên Không & Thế Giới Lập Phương
Cuộc đào thoát sinh tử qua 5 ải địa hình đầy thử thách trước làn sóng Zombie đang truy đuổi không ngừng. Phối hợp cùng đồng đội vượt chướng ngại vật, mở khóa các cơ chế bản đồ và cố thủ tại những điểm phòng thủ trọng yếu để cầm chân kẻ địch. Chỉ với tinh thần đồng đội và những pha phối hợp chính xác, cả đội mới có thể sống sót và chạm tới điểm thoát hiểm cuối cùng.

Mode Trốn Tìm (Hide and Seek)
Màn đấu trí căng thẳng giữa Thợ Săn và Phe Trốn. Biến hình thành những vật thể quen thuộc trong văn phòng để hòa mình vào môi trường và đánh lừa đối thủ. Trong khi đó, Thợ Săn phải vận dụng khả năng quan sát và phán đoán để truy tìm từng mục tiêu đang ẩn nấp. Liệu phe Trốn có thể cầm cự đến cuối cùng, hay sẽ bị quét sạch trước khi thời gian kết thúc?

Boss Thế Giới – Anh Em Quyền Ma
Thử thách sinh tồn luyện ngục khốc liệt nhất lịch sử! Đối đầu cặp Boss song sinh Lửa và Băng trong trận chiến đầy thử thách. Phối hợp cùng đồng đội né tránh những đòn tấn công hủy diệt, tìm ra điểm yếu của kẻ địch và tung ra hỏa lực tối đa để giành chiến thắng. Hạ gục Anh Em Quyền Ma để có cơ hội nhận được những vũ khí vĩnh viễn giá trị.

Chế Độ Đặt Bom C4 Kinh Điển
Chế độ C4 Phòng thủ vững chắc, tấn công bùng nổ. Một sai lầm nhỏ, cả team trả giá!
Trận chiến 5v5 chiến thuật kinh điển, nơi 10 người chơi chia hai phe: Black List và Global Risk. Một đội đặt bom và tấn công; đội còn lại phòng thủ và gỡ bom. Chiến lược, độ chính xác và phối hợp đồng đội quyết định thắng thua.

Chế Độ Team Deathmatch
Chế độ đấu đội căng từng giây, nóng từng nhịp. Hồi sinh chớp nhoáng, giao tranh không ngừng, từng giây từng phút đều quyết định thắng bại. Thử thách phản xạ, khẳng định bản lĩnh và làm chủ chiến trường!

data.name: Gartic Phone
data.description_full:
Gartic Phone is the hilarious online telephone game with drawings!

Start with a sentence. The next player draws it. The player after that writes what they see. On it goes, sentence to drawing to sentence, until the original idea is gloriously, ridiculously lost. Then watch the whole chain play back and laugh together at how it all went wrong.

Free, easy to learn, and impossible to play with a straight face. Perfect for friends, family, classrooms, parties and online hangouts, and no drawing skills required. The worse the art, the better the game!

HOW TO PLAY
• Create a room and invite friends with a link or QR code, or jump into a quick game.
• Everyone writes a starting sentence.
• Pass it on: take turns drawing the sentence above you, then guessing the drawing below.
• When the round ends, flip through every album and relive the chaos.

LOADS OF GAME MODES
Keep every game fresh with a huge variety of modes, including:
• Normal: the classic write-and-draw telephone
• Knock-Off: everyone draws the same first sentence
• Animation: build frame-by-frame animated chains
• Background & Solo: draw over a shared scene or play on your own
• Secret, Masterpiece, Compliment Sandwich and many more

CREATIVE DRAWING TOOLS
• Pencil, eraser, shapes, fill bucket, eyedropper and notes
• Full color palette with adjustable thickness and opacity
• Pinch to zoom, pan, and a dedicated landscape drawing mode for extra room
• Undo, redo and an optional grid

SHARE THE LAUGHS
• Save and share your favorite albums as animated GIFs
• Replay each drawing stroke by stroke

PLAY YOUR WAY
• 100% free and online — play with friends near or far
• Available in 40+ languages
• Custom avatars and rooms you control

Gather your friends and start a round now. Chaos guaranteed!

data.name: Arrow Cash Go
data.description_full:
Welcome to Arrow Cash GO!

Arrow Cash GO is a fast-paced, addictive puzzle game where your goal is to clear the board by tapping on directional markers to remove them. Every successful tap earns you in-game cash, which you can accumulate and eventually withdraw as real money!

How to Play

The game presents you with a board filled with multiple lines, each marked with a direction indicator pointing either horizontally or vertically. Your task is to tap on these indicators to make the lines slide out of the board in the direction they point.

However, it's not as simple as it sounds! Lines can block each other. If the path a line needs to take is blocked by another line, it gets "stuck." A line can be blocked up to three times—if it gets blocked three times, the level is failed. You'll need to think strategically about which markers to tap first to clear the board successfully.


Earn & Withdraw Real Cash

Every time you successfully tap and clear a marker, you earn in-game bills. The more levels you complete, the more bills you collect! These bills can be exchanged for real cash withdrawals.

data.name: Crackface: Guess the Character
data.description_full:
Crackface turns any table into a secret-character showdown for 2–4 players. Everyone secretly picks a character. Then you take turns asking yes/no questions — "Does your character wear a hat?" — and cross suspects off the board until just one is left. Be the first to call your opponent's character by name, and the case is closed.

No ten-minute rulebook. Swipe through three cards and you're playing.

It's the classic face-guessing game you grew up with — rebuilt for 2 to 4 players, three ways to play, and characters of your own.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
• Pass & Play — one phone for the whole table. Make your pick, hide it, hand it over.
• No-Pass — everyone on their own phone in the same room. Hand the phone over once at the start to set your secret pick, then play with no more passing.
• Online — host a room, give friends a 6-character code or QR, and everyone plays from their own phone. Both games play online.

TWO MATCH MODES
• Blitz — the first correct call wins. Fast, tense, one shot.
• Classic — everyone gets to answer; the winner is whoever needed the fewest turns (and the least time on a tie).

AND A SECOND GAME: FIND THE MOLE (3–20 players)
Almost everyone at the table is looking at the same character. Almost. The mole is holding a different one — and doesn't know they're the mole. Mr. Nobody is holding nothing at all and has to bluff. Go round the table, a word or a question each, then vote on who doesn't belong. Unmask the outsiders, or survive as one of them. One phone or online, same as the main game.

THEMED PACKS FOR EVERY TABLE
Start with animals, dinosaurs, sea life, professions, world mythology, mythical creatures, space, aliens, cyberpunk, the wild west, sweets and fast food — and plenty more. Some packs are free from the start; the rest unlock as an optional set, and the catalogue keeps growing.

BUILD YOUR OWN BOARD
The best packs are the ones you make yourself. Pull photos from your gallery or snap them on the camera and turn anything you love into the game — original characters, inside jokes, and the people who want to be on the board. Up to 200 characters in a pack. Share a finished pack with a friend as a link or as a single file.

WHY YOU'LL KEEP PLAYING
• 2 to 4 players in the main game, up to 20 in Find the Mole — easy to teach either way
• Plays in minutes — perfect for a coffee break, a road trip, a party, or breaking the ice
• Pick your board size and a turn timer to set the pace
• A different house rule waiting each day, if you want one — ask every question in a noir detective voice, or let each player lie once per game
• Track your stats: games played, fastest win, favourite packs
• Localized in 15 languages

Pick a face. Ask the right questions. Crack it before they crack yours.

Refined Order & Market Management！
Expand your customer base via diversified marketing campaigns to attract buyers from all regions. Arrange order schedules reasonably to balance production and delivery, steadily boost overall revenue and achieve long-term growth for your timber trading business.

You will gain exclusive industry points upon every completed order. Allocate these points wisely to unlock global buffs that permanently lift your factory’s productivity and profit ceiling. data.name: Perisher Exeunt CoCo
data.description_full:
"## Gameplay

- **Objective**: In each level, you must successfully guide the laser beam emitted by the Emitter to the target Receiver and reflect it through a series of mirrors.
- **Controls**:
- **Rotate Mirror**: Click and drag a mirror to rotate it 360 degrees, changing the angle of the laser's reflection.
- **Move Mirror**: In some levels, the mirror can be dragged to different positions.
- **Challenge Elements**:
- **Obstacles**: The laser cannot penetrate these obstacles, so you must navigate around them.
- **Time Limit**: Each level has a countdown, and you must complete it within the allotted time. The remaining time counts towards your score.

## Core Features

- **15 Carefully Designed Levels**: From easy beginners to challenging mazes, the difficulty increases gradually.
- **High Score Leaderboard**: Compete with your friends! Your score is calculated based on the levels you complete and the time remaining, and is recorded on the local leaderboard. - **Customizable Themes**: Multiple visual themes are available (e.g., blue, green, and orange), which players can switch between in the settings to suit their preferences.
- **Immersive Sound Effects**: A variety of built-in sound effects enhance the game's responsiveness and immersion.
- **Intuitive User Interface**: A simple and beautiful floating user interface provides a smooth gaming experience."

data.name: 3D Bubble Pop：Relaxing ASMR
data.description_full:
🦦 Game Overview
*3D Bubble Pop: Relaxing ASMR* is a stress-relieving gift brought to you by a perpetually chill capybara.
In this fresh take on the classic bubble shooter, there is only one thing to do: aim, shoot, and pop. The slightly tilted 3D perspective makes the trajectory of every bubble clearly visible. As colorful bubbles collide and burst in mid-air, you’re treated to more than just a rising score; finely tuned ASMR sound effects provide a dual relaxation experience for both your fingertips and your ears.
No complex storylines or maps to unlock here—just a capybara hanging out with you, a pristine 3D bubble world, and a journey of popping bubbles that lets your mind completely unwind.

---
🎮 Gameplay
Core Rules: Match colors to pop groups of three.
The rules are simple, though the shooting angle requires a bit of thought.
- Shoot Bubbles: A colored bubble is loaded into the launcher at the bottom of the screen. Aim at the cluster of bubbles above and fire.
- Clear Bubbles: When your shot connects with a group of three or more bubbles of the same color, that group pops and falls away.
- Clear the Level: Eliminate all the suspended bubbles to advance to the next level.
Strategy & Tips
- Use Ricochets: Bubbles bounce off the side walls. If a direct path is blocked, use the walls to bank your shot—this requires a little quick mental geometry.
- Watch for Gravity: When a group pops, unsupported bubbles will fall due to gravity; these falling bubbles count toward your score too. Targeting key support points first can trigger a satisfying chain reaction of falling bubbles. ---
🎨 Clean 3D Visuals
- Slightly Tilted Perspective: The game employs a slightly tilted 3D view, allowing you to clearly see the depth and layering of the stacked bubbles without making aiming difficult due to an extreme angle. This design preserves the classic bubble-shooter field of view while adding a sense of realistic spatial depth.
- Minimalist Background: There are no complex theme changes; the game features a single, soft, gradient background with a frosted-glass texture. All visual elements serve the gameplay—free of superfluous decorations—letting you focus entirely on the joy of shooting.
- Bubble Texture: Each bubble boasts a translucent, glossy sheen with light playing across its surface, accompanied by subtle expansion and contraction animations upon impact.
🧘 Stress-Free, Pure Gameplay
- No Time Limits: No countdown timers rush you through levels; take your time adjusting your aim to find the perfect shot trajectory.
- No Forced Tasks: There are no daily missions to complete, nor stars or keys to collect. Simply open the game, start popping, and pick it up or put it down whenever you like.

---
✅ Summary
"Aim, shoot, and listen to the bubbles pop. Let the Capybara keep you company during a gentle, leisurely break."
*3D Bubble Pop: Relaxing ASMR* is a bubble-shooting game that returns to the classics with a focus on stress relief. It strips away complex progression and collection systems, leaving only the core fun of aiming, bouncing, and popping. Exquisite ASMR-quality sound effects, a calm Capybara companion, and clean 3D visuals combine to create a tranquil space where you can relax your mind anytime, anywhere.
Whether you are a veteran bubble-shooter player or simply looking for a way to unwind and find some peace, you’ll find your own rhythm here.
Open the game, adjust your angle, and join the Capybara in watching the bubbles bloom in the air.

We hope you enjoy the game! If you have any thoughts or suggestions, please feel free to contact us.
data.description_short: Experience the thrill and precision of 3D bubble popping!

data.name: Bus Crowd - Traffic Jam
data.description_full:
Welcome to Bus Crowd, a colorful bus puzzle game built around traffic jam strategy, passenger matching, and smart parking choices. 🚌🚦

A crowded station is full of waiting passengers, and buses with different colors and seat capacities are ready to roll. - Fill Buses to Open Slots: A full vehicle departs and opens its parking space for another move. Avoid leaving buses that are not fully filled in the slots for too long.

- Use Boosters When Stuck: Helpful boosters can adjust buses, guide passengers, or open paths when a tricky jam blocks your progress. 🚀

🌟 Game Features

- Bus Out Challenge: Study the arrows, send the right vehicles out of crowded layouts, and enjoy the moment when a blocked station finally starts moving.
- Bus Escape Moments: Fill buses, open lanes, and create clever escape style solutions as each full vehicle leaves the station. 🚍
- Traffic Escape Challenge: Handle car jam inspired layouts, parking jam pressure, and bus rush moments with careful observation instead of random moves.
- Brain Teaser Levels: Count seats, compare passengers, and use smart strategy to solve each puzzle with a real sense of progress. 🧠
- Passenger Matching Flow: Watch large crowds stream into colorful buses, see vehicles depart one by one, and turn chaos into a smooth boarding flow.
- Diverse Boosters: Use different tools for buses and passengers, then decide which option gives the best value when the station gets tricky. ✨
- Bright 3D Station Scenes: Enjoy vivid buses, lively passengers, smooth boarding animations, and relaxing traffic flow.

Bus Crowd is made for players who enjoy bus games, parking games, bus mania, color sort puzzles, traffic jam puzzles, and clever car jam challenges. Match passengers, fill buses, open parking slots, and solve each bus game with satisfying flow. Download Bus Crowd today and master the jam! 🚦

data.name: Chimera TCG
data.description_full:
Real animals. Strange splices. Stranger battles.

Chimera TCG is a strategic collectible card game where you splice real animals into creatures that have never existed, collect them, and build a deck for battle.

COLLECT THE ANIMAL KINGDOM

Start with 54 real animal Base cards, each with nature-documentary field notes, an environment, a size, and a trait. Great White Shark. Golden Eagle. Honey Badger. The building blocks of a much stranger collection.

SPLICE SOMETHING NEW

Combine two Base cards in the Splicer to create a Chimera. Every pairing is valid. Compatible animals are easier to Splice, while unlikely combinations can produce rarer results at greater risk.

Add a third Base card to attempt a Mythic Chimera. Use Stabilizers to improve your odds, or stack three Stabilizers for a guaranteed success.

DISCOVER WHAT NO ONE HAS

When someone successfully Splices a brand-new combination, its name, artwork, and field notes are created on the spot. Discover it first and you are credited in the shared catalog as its Origin Splicer.

BATTLE ACROSS THREE LANES

Build a 12-card deck and battle across Land, Water, and Air in a six-turn match. Spend energy to play cards face-down, then watch both sides reveal simultaneously. Win two of the three lanes to take the match.

Build around card abilities, trait interactions, and home-lane advantages. Fight adaptive rivals, climb from Novice toward Master, compete on the weekly wins leaderboard, or challenge friends in live head-to-head battles.

GROW YOUR COLLECTION

Earn XP by battling, Splicing, and opening packs. Spend Coins to level up your favorite cards, and Recycle spare duplicates into more Coins.

Send Field Expeditions that return with free cards. Complete daily quests, progress through a new Battle Pass each month, and earn rewards as your collection grows.

CHASE VARIANTS AND COMPLETE LINEAGES

Collect special Variants with alternate artwork and Battle bonuses, including limited-time seasonal styles such as Steampunk. Complete animal Lineages to earn Silver and Gold Leaf Variants, fill your Trophy Case, and unlock collection rewards.

FREE TO PLAY

Build your collection, Splice Chimeras, and battle without spending money. Optional in-app purchases are available. An internet connection is required.

In-app purchases and randomized items: Some optional card packs contain randomized cards. Exact odds and selection rules are shown in the app before purchase and at chimeratcg.app/odds.html. Catalog-based odds may change as players discover new Chimeras. Gems cannot be exchanged for real money.

Your goal is simple: move the nuts one by one until every screw holds a perfect stack of a single color. No timers. No rush. Just the calm satisfaction of watching messy piles transform into neat, matching towers.
Game Features:
- Sort, Stack, and Solve
Each level gives you a set of screws loaded with mixed-up colorful nuts. Pick up the top nut from any screw and place it onto another — but only if the colors match or the screw is empty. It’s easy to pick up, yet every move asks you to plan ahead.
- A Fresh Twist on Classic Sorting
If you love water sort or ball sort puzzles, you’ll feel right at home. Nut Stack：Sort Puzzle takes that familiar, deeply satisfying sorting loop and gives it a tactile new feel — Stacking nuts onto screws feels crisp, chunky, and impossibly satisfying.
- Relax at Your Own Pace
There are no clocks, no countdowns, and no fail states. Take as much time as you need. Undo a move, rethink your strategy, and enjoy the soothing rhythm of sorting. This is a puzzle game designed to calm your mind, not test your nerves.
- From Simple to Clever
Early levels are gentle and welcoming, with just a few colors and plenty of room to move. As you progress, more screws, more nuts, and tighter arrangements appear — turning each puzzle into a quietly rewarding brain teaser that keeps you engaged without ever feeling unfair.
- Satisfying Every Time
When the last nut clicks into place and a messy screw becomes a flawless single-color stack, the moment is pure satisfaction. Smooth animations and gentle sound effects make every completion feel like a small victory.
Why You’ll Love Nut Stack：Sort Puzzle:
- If you love sorting, organizing, and tidying things up, this game was made for you.
- If you enjoy puzzle games that let you play at your own speed — on the couch, on a break, or winding down at night — you’ll feel right at home.
- If you’re looking for a distraction-free game that keeps your mind quietly engaged without stress, this is it.
- If you find joy in watching scattered pieces come together into perfect order, you’ll keep coming back for more.
Download Nut Stack：Sort Puzzle today and start sorting the nuts, one move at a time.
data.description_short: Stack and separate nuts across bolts. A quiet puzzle to sort your thoughts, too.

data.name: Война за трон
data.description_full:
«Война за трон» — это инновационная средневековая idle-игра на выживание, сочетающая стратегический игровой процесс с обилием подробностей, которые только и ждут, чтобы вы их исследовали.

Когда внезапный мятеж резко меняет судьбу целой династии и разжигает уровопролитную войну, бесчисленное количество человек теряют дома. В этом мире, разрываемом на части дезорганизацией общества, вторжениями мятежников, свирепствующими болезнями, а также монстрами, отчаянно жаждущими ресурсов, сложнейшая задача — это выживание. Как раз в эти смутные времена вы и становитесь губернатором, и именно от вас зависит, сможете ли вы провести своих людей через все опасности, продумывая внутренние и дипломатические стратегии, которые помогут вам вновь раздуть искру цивилизации.

[Ключевые функции]

Защищайтесь от вторжений
Оставайтесь начеку и будьте готовы в любой момент отразить вторжение. От этого зависит ваш город, последний бастион надежды человечества. Собирайте ресурсы, улучшайте оборону и готовьтесь к бою, чтобы обеспечить выживание ваших подданных в эти сложные времена.

Управляйте кадрами
Наслаждайтесь уникальной игровой механикой, которая позволяет вам назначать выживших на такие позиции, как рабочий, охотник или повар. Следите за здоровьем и счастьем выживших, чтобы они работали продуктивно. Быстро реагируйте на заболевания, чтобы все вовремя получали доступ к лечению.

Устанавливайте законы
Кодексы законов чрезвычайно важны для любой цивилизации и станут ключом к росту и силе вашего города.

[Стратегический игровой процесс]

Борьба за ресурсы
Ввиду внезапного падения государства весь континент усыпан нетронутыми ресурсами. Беженцы, мятежники и жадные до власти губернаторы все как один хотят заполучить эти драгоценные материалы. Приготовьтесь к бою и используйте каждую каплю стратегии в вашем распоряжении, чтобы забрать эти ресурсы себе!

Сражайтесь за силу
Соревнуйтесь с другими игроками за высшую честь: звание сильнейшего губернатора в этой грандиозной игре-стратегии. Взойдите на трон и правьте королевством!

Создавайте альянсы
Сделайте задачу выжить в этом хаотичном мире проще, создав альянс или вступив в существующий. Работайте сообща с союзниками, чтобы восстановить цивилизацию!

Нанимайте героев
В игре присутствует множество уникальных героев, которых вы сможете нанять. Составьте свою команду героев с разными навыками и талантами, чтобы перехватить инициативу и обеспечить своему городу толику безопасности в эти отчаянные времена.

Соревнуйтесь с другими губернаторами
Оттачивайте навыки своих героев, собирайте отряды и сражайтесь с другими губернаторами. Победа не только принесёт вам ценные очки, но и даст доступ к редким предметам. Возглавьте рейтинги и продемонстрируйте взлёт великой цивилизации.

Продвигайте технологии
Мятеж уничтожил практически все прежние технологические достижения, так что одно из ваших самых важных дел — это восстановить и возродить фрагменты утерянных технологий. Гонка освоения новейших технологий может определить, кто будет доминировать в этом новом мировом порядке!

data.name: People Jam: Seat Puzzle
data.description_full:
🚌 Bus Jam — Pick the Right Color, Avoid the Crash! 🚌

Passengers are waiting on a moving conveyor belt. Each one has a color — red, blue, yellow, green. Your job? Tap the bus that matches their color and send it to pick them up. Simple, right? Wait — the buses are parked all over the lot, and every bus has a direction arrow.

🎯 How It Works
Watch the conveyor belt. A red passenger appears. Tap the red bus. That bus will drive along its arrow path to pick up the passenger, then leave the lot. New passengers keep coming as the belt cycles.

🚧 Don’t Let Buses Collide
Buses move along fixed arrows. If two buses’ paths cross at the wrong time — crash! You’ll have to decide which bus to call first, which to hold back, and how to clear the lot without a single fender bender.

🔄 More Passengers, More Buses
The belt never stops. Passengers arrive in random colors, sometimes in groups. The parking lot is messy at first — buses pointing every which way. You’ll need to think ahead: call the bus that won’t hit another, or wait for a better moment.

📦 Clear Every Bus
Your goal is to drive every bus out of the lot, each one loaded with its matching passenger(s). Just a smooth, collision‑free operation.

Can you untangle the bus jam and get everyone to their ride? Tap, match, and roll out — but don’t let them crash! 🚦🚍🔴🔵🟡🟢

data.name: Fruit King: Drop Match Puzzle
data.description_full:
Drop cute fruits, merge matching fruits, and become the Fruit King!

Fruit King: Drop Match Puzzle is a fun and easy fruit puzzle game where you drop adorable fruit blocks, merge the same fruits, and create bigger and bigger fruits. If you enjoy fruit games, merge games, drop puzzles, block puzzles, or matching puzzle games, this cute fruit puzzle is made for you.

The rules are simple. Drop a fruit into the box, match it with the same fruit, and watch them merge into a bigger fruit. Keep merging fruits to create larger fruits, aim for the final melon, and challenge your best score. It is easy to start, but the more fruits you drop, the more strategy you need.

Fruit King combines the fun of a fruit merge puzzle, the simple control of a drop puzzle, and the satisfying challenge of a block puzzle. Every fruit drop matters. Where should you place the next fruit? Which fruits should you merge first? How can you keep enough space inside the box? Think carefully, drop smartly, and keep your fruit blocks under control.

Enjoy quick play, relaxing breaks, and high-score challenges anytime, anywhere. Simple one-hand controls make it easy to play, while cute fruits, clean design, and bright colors make every round feel fresh and satisfying.

How to Play

1. Drop fruit blocks into the box.
2. Match the same fruits to merge them.
3. Create bigger and bigger fruits.
4. Keep the fruits from overflowing.
5. Reach the final melon and aim for the highest score.

The more you merge, the bigger your fruits become. Small fruits turn into larger fruits, larger fruits lead to even bigger fruits, and the biggest fruit can give you extra score when matched. Plan your fruit drops, build merge chains, and keep the box open as long as you can.

Why You’ll Love Fruit King

- Simple and addictive fruit puzzle gameplay
- Cute fruits and colorful block puzzle design
- Fun merge puzzle mechanics
- Easy one-hand drop puzzle controls
- Satisfying matching game moments
- High-score challenge with replay value
- Great for fans of fruit games and casual puzzle games
- Relaxing, easy to learn, and fun to master

If you like watermelon-style games, fruit merge games, block puzzle games, or casual matching games, Fruit King is a great choice. Drop fruits, merge fruits, match fruits, and keep building bigger fruits until you reach the final melon.

Every round gives you a new chance to beat your best score. One smart fruit drop can open up space. One perfect merge can create a chain reaction. One careful move can save the whole game. That is what makes this fruit block puzzle simple, exciting, and addictive.

Fruit King is not just about dropping fruits randomly. To get a high score, you need to think ahead. Place small fruits carefully, keep similar fruits close together, and save space for bigger fruits. The better your strategy, the longer you can keep merging fruits.

This cute fruit puzzle game is made for players who enjoy simple rules, satisfying merges, and score-based challenges. Play for a few minutes or keep going for a new record. Fruit King is easy to enjoy in short sessions, but it also gives you plenty of reasons to try again.

Recommended for fans of fruit puzzle games, merge puzzle games, drop puzzle games, block puzzle games, matching games, cute fruit games, watermelon-style puzzle games, casual games, easy games, and relaxing puzzle games.

Drop the fruit, match the fruit, merge the fruit, and create the biggest fruit. The goal is simple, but every game feels different. With each new fruit block, you need to make a better choice and aim for a better score.

Fruit King: Drop Match Puzzle brings together cute fruits, simple controls, strategic fruit merging, and satisfying puzzle gameplay. Start with small fruits, build bigger fruits, reach the melon, and become the true Fruit King.

Play now and enjoy a fun fruit merge puzzle full of cute fruits, smart drops, colorful blocks, and exciting high-score challenges!

data.name: Kung Fight: Action RPG
data.description_full:
Enter Kung Fight, a brutal RPG survival game where every fight makes your street fighter stronger. Battle through punks, gangs, cyborg bosses, and strange enemies in nonstop idle combat. Every victory drops gold, energy, shards, and stat boosts that push your RPG build further. Train, upgrade, unlock new combos, and survive wave after wave of enemies.

Kung Fight Combat
Punch, kick, spin, jump, and chain powerful combos against dangerous enemies. Use basic strikes, special skills, and heavy attacks to crush every spawner, clear zones, and prepare for brutal boss fights. Each enemy brings loot, progress, and another step toward survival.

Slot Training Evolution
This is not just fighting — it’s RPG growth through training. Use the Punching Bag, Treadmill, Pull-up Bar, and Bench Press to spin for permanent stats. Build Hands, Legs, Spin, Jump, HP, Crit Chance, Crit Damage, Evasion, and Move Speed. Every spin can change your fighter’s power.

Combo Upgrade System
Collect shards from enemies and bosses to unlock and upgrade new combat combos. Master rare skills, improve damage, trigger lifesteal, double loot, and technique bonuses. Choose your strongest combo setup and evolve your fighter beyond limits.

Boss Survival
Defeat powerful bosses to unlock new zones, new combo slots, and harder enemies. Each boss fight tests your build, your upgrades, and your survival power. The stronger your fighter becomes, the deeper you push into the RPG world.

Infinite Power
Start as a weak street fighter and grow into an unstoppable combat machine. Farm enemies, complete quests, save friends, collect loot, train stats, upgrade combos, and dominate every boss standing in your way.

How long can your fighter survive? In this Kung Fight RPG survival game, every enemy, every upgrade, and every boss makes you stronger.

data.name: Город грехов: Путь босса
data.description_full:
Добро пожаловать в Город грехов: Путь босса!

Здесь власть не дают просто так. Её забирают силой, хитростью и верными людьми. Улицы полны денег, предательства и опасных сделок, а каждый район ждёт того, кто сможет подчинить его себе.

Начните путь с самых низов и станьте боссом криминальной империи. Нанимайте людей вне закона, головорезов, карателей и главарей, собирайте сильный отряд, усиливайте персонажей, забирайте ресурсы и расширяйте своё влияние. В этом городе вы либо правите, либо становитесь чьей-то добычей.

[Соберите свою банду]
Нанимайте мафиози, уличных бойцов, гонщиков, байкеров и подпольных боссов со всего Города грехов. У каждого персонажа своя роль, стиль боя и набор навыков. Комбинируйте урон, защиту, контроль и поддержку, чтобы собрать отряд, который сможет разнести любого противника.

[Сражайтесь без лишней рутины]
Автобой берёт грязную работу на себя. Развивайте персонажей, подбирайте состав команды, усиливайте экипировку и грамотно распределяйте ресурсы, а ваша банда сама разберётся с теми, кто встанет у неё на пути. Уличные стычки, войны за территорию и ежедневные подземелья станут проще и быстрее.

[Забирайте добычу каждый день]
Улицы щедры к тем, кто не боится драки. Проходите ежедневные испытания, побеждайте противников и получайте ресурсы для прокачки команды. Каждая победа усиливает вашу банду, расширяет влияние и приближает вас к вершине криминального мира.

[Постройте преступную империю]
Казино, ночные клубы, подпольный бизнес и грязные деньги: всё это может работать на вас. Развивайте свою организацию, объединяйтесь с другими игроками, укрепляйте синдикат и превращайте уличную банду в настоящую мафиозную империю.

[Живите как настоящий босс]
Дорогие машины, роскошные особняки, горы налички, эффектные спутницы и власть над городом. Наслаждайтесь жизнью на вершине, но помните: чем выше вы поднимаетесь, тем больше желающих сбросить вас вниз.

[Пройдите путь власти и предательства]
Вас ждёт история амбиций, мести, опасных союзов и жестокой борьбы за влияние. Вы встретите союзников и противников, примете непростые решения и сами определите свою судьбу. Останетесь мелким уличным головорезом или станете главным боссом Города грехов?

Войдите в Город грехов: Путь босса прямо сейчас. Призывайте людей вне закона, усиливайте банду, проходите испытания, захватывайте улицы и постройте собственную криминальную империю!


Связаться с нами:
Conflict3D@hotmail.com

data.name: Color Hide & Seek: Friend Hunt

The seeker is coming, and the only thing between you and getting caught

environment, freeze in place, and pray they walk right past you.

🎨 PAINT AND DISAPPEAR
Change your color to match any surface in the map. Red brick, green
grass, blue tiles — pick wrong and you're the most obvious thing in the
room.

🕵️ HIDE OR SEEK
Play both sides. Outsmart the seeker as a hider, or learn to spot the
one object in the room that doesn't belong.

🗺️ MAPS BUILT FOR HIDING
Explore colorful levels packed with hiding spots, fake props and
sightlines that reward players who think ahead.

🎮 FEATURES
- Color camouflage hide and seek gameplay
- Prop hunt style rounds with hiders and seekers
- Dozens of unique maps and hiding spots
- Unlock new characters and skins
- Simple controls, quick rounds

data.name: Print Sort: Color Puzzle
data.description_full:
What if a puzzle game could stretch your brain, calm your nerves, and let you watch adorable little ducks take shape right before your eyes?
That's Print Sort: Color Puzzle.
Moving beyond traditional color-sorting mechanics, Print Sort brings together two unexpected worlds: path-solving puzzles and 3D printing. You're not just clearing a static grid — you're fueling a fleet of 3D printers, each one hungry for its own color.
🖨️ More Than a Puzzle — It's a Print Lab
When you open the game, here's what you'll see:
In the workspace above, a few 3D printers sit quietly, each holding an empty mold, ready to bring a duck to life.
Below, a maze of vibrant lines twists and crisscrosses the board. Each one acts as a tube of 3D printing filament, and along every line you'll find directional arrows — waiting for your command.
Your mission: tap the right arrows, route each color along its path, and deliver the material into the matching printer. With every line delivered, your duck grows a little more — collect them all, and it's complete.
That moment — watching a tiny duck slowly take shape — feels a little like childhood, the same joy as watching clay come alive.
🧠 Where's the Challenge?
It looks simple. It isn't:
- Multiple colors weave through each other — one wrong tap, and you'll lose a life. You only get three.
- Short routes often block longer ones — plan your order, or stay stuck.
- In later levels, a single arrow can change the flow of an entire line.
- Stuck? Hint bulbs light up a safe move when you need one.
Every level feels like unraveling a colorful ball of yarn — find the right thread to pull, and the whole puzzle opens up.
🌿 Designed for Calm Minds
We built Print Sort to be the little reset button in your day — for commutes, lunch breaks, or those last quiet minutes before sleep:
- No timer — think as slowly as you like.
- No energy system — play for one minute or even for one hour.
- Play offline — works on planes, subways, anywhere.
- Soft visuals — neon lines on dark backgrounds, easy on the eyes.
- Soothing sounds — every successful print rewards you with a gentle chime.
✨ Who Will Love It?
- Puzzle fans who want a brain workout without time pressure.
- Suckers for cute, soothing visuals.
- Busy people looking for a mindful pocket of calm.
- Gamers wanting an accessible puzzle that all skill levels can play together.
- Curious players who just couldn't resist the idea of a 3D-printing duck game.
🌈 Start Your Print Sort Journey
Tap your first arrow. Watch the color start to flow. The moment your first little duck takes shape, you'll know — this one's different.

data.name: Mahjong Crush: Tile Match
data.description_full:

🀄 Slide to match
Push a tile and watch it glide. When two matching suits meet, they disappear. The satisfying click of a clean collision never gets old.

🧩 Think a few moves ahead
Each slide shifts the whole board. A good move creates a chain; a careless one closes off your options. Levels start approachable and gradually ask more of you — planning a sequence, setting up combos, working around the layout.

🌿 Play at your own pace
No countdown timers. Take your time to read the board, line up the right push, and feel the quiet satisfaction of a well-played level. If you get stuck, hints and shuffle are there when you need them.

✨ Clean visuals, clear tiles
Large, sharp tiles that are easy to read — especially on bigger screens. Smooth animations and subtle feedback on every match, without going overboard.

data.name: โลกสวนดอกไม้ของฉัน
data.description_full:
เกมปลูกดอกไม้สุดฮิตที่ผู้เล่นทั่วโลกหลงรัก เตรียมเปิดให้บริการในไทยอย่างเป็นทางการวันที่ 3 มิถุนายน!
กิจกรรมเล่นเกมลุ้นรับดอกไม้จริงเปิดให้ร่วมสนุกได้ตลอด พร้อมจัดส่งตรงถึงบ้านสำหรับผู้เล่นในประเทศไทย!

โลกสวนดอกไม้ของฉันเป็นเกมจำลองสถานการณ์ที่ผ่อนคลายและเยียวยาจิตใจ ที่นี่คุณจะได้พบเพื่อนรักดอกไม้มากมาย และสร้างสังคมเพื่อนรักดอกไม้ของคุณเอง
เกมนี้เล่นง่าย เริ่มต้นได้ทันที ทุกครั้งที่ปลูกดอกไม้ก็มีความตื่นเต้นเล็กๆ รอคุณอยู่ เราอยากมอบความโรแมนติกจากโลกเสมือนมาสู่มือคุณจริงๆ!

〓 โชคดีมาแล้ว ‧ ดอกไม้สดส่งฟรีถึงบ้าน 〓
ความโรแมนติกสุดพิเศษสำหรับคุณ! เพียงปลูกดอกไม้ในเกม เมื่อเก็บเกี่ยวดอกไม้ที่โตเต็มที่ คุณมีโอกาสได้รับการ์ดอวยพรดอกไม้ และแลกเป็นช่อดอกไม้สดส่งตรงถึงบ้านฟรีเลย!

〓 ปลูกดอกไม้สบายๆ ‧ สร้างสวนเฉพาะของคุณ 〓
ในสวนเฉพาะของคุณ ปลูกดูแลกล้วยไม้ ลีลาวดี ดอกมะลิ และดอกไม้มากมายด้วยมือคุณเอง เพลิดเพลินกับช่วงเวลาการปลูกที่ผ่อนคลายและบำบัดใจ ปล่อยวางความเครียดทีละนิด พร้อมสัมผัสความอบอุ่นจากเพื่อนดอกไม้ที่อยู่เคียงข้าง

〓 สนุกกับเพื่อน ‧ คลายเครียดด้วยสังคมเกม 〓
ในสวนไม่มีคำว่าเหงา! ผูกมิตรกับเพื่อนซี้ เข้าร่วมกิลด์ เยี่ยมชมสวนเพื่อน หรือแม้แต่ "แอบขโมย" ดอกไม้จากเพื่อนได้ด้วย! สัมผัสประสบการณ์การเล่นที่สนุกสนานและผ่อนคลาย ทุกการพบเจอคือความประหลาดใจ

〓 ศิลปะการจัดดอกไม้ ‧ สร้างสรรค์ชีวิตมีระดับ 〓
ดอกไม้ที่เก็บเกี่ยวไม่ได้มีไว้ชมเท่านั้น แต่ยังจัดแต่งได้อย่างอิสระ ผสมผสานแจกันและดอกไม้หลากหลายชนิด สร้างสรรค์ผลงานจัดดอกไม้ของคุณเอง ตั้งแต่เลือกสีสันไปจนถึงสไตล์ ออกแบบสุนทรียภาพที่เป็นเอกลักษณ์เฉพาะตัว

〓 บริหารร้านดอกไม้ ‧ สัมผัสชีวิตเจ้าของร้าน 〓
รับออเดอร์ จัดทำ ขาย ขยายร้านดอกไม้ของคุณทีละขั้นตอน สร้างร้านดอกไม้ยอดนิยมของคุณอย่างค่อยเป็นค่อยไป ใช้กลยุทธ์การบริหารเพื่อเพิ่มรายได้ ให้สวนและร้านค้าเติบโตไปพร้อมกัน

〓 สัตว์เลี้ยงแสนน่ารัก ‧ เยียวยาใจเป็นสองเท่า 〓
ดูแลน้องแมวน่ารักในบ้านแมว ให้อาหาร ลูบไล้ ตกแต่งพื้นที่ส่วนตัว เพลิดเพลินกับช่วงเวลาแห่งความอบอุ่นที่มีเพื่อนซี้สี่ขาอยู่เคียงข้าง!

And yes, it’s hard. In fact, some say it's difficult, others call it impossible. But every puzzle is built with purpose and can be solved with logic. Each hard level is designed to challenge your thinking in a unique way. If you're a fan of brain training, mind games, or just enjoy testing your limits, you'll find yourself right at home.

Each level is full of hidden ideas and clever mechanics waiting to be discovered. You'll experiment with sound, light, rotation, and pressure, even waiting. Solutions are not always obvious. But when you find them, the satisfaction is incredible, making it a memorable hard puzzle game experience.

Designed for fans of both classic and modern puzzle games, Game is Hard avoids the noise of the typical mobile fun games and focuses instead on clarity, challenge, and meaningful interaction. There’s no time pressure. No ads. No noise. Just deep puzzles that respect your intelligence.
Whether you see yourself as a genius, an impulse problem-solver, or simply someone who enjoys a good brainly test, this game invites you to try. And try again. And maybe finally succeed.

data.name: 10th Floor: Elevator Anomalies
data.description_full:
You just wanted to get home after another exhausting shift at the shawarma stand.

Night. Empty streets. Flickering lights. A grim post-Soviet apartment block.

Near the entrance, an old woman stops you and asks for spare change. You ignore her and walk inside without thinking twice.

A few seconds later, you realize something is terribly wrong.

The elevator keeps going up for far too long.
The floors begin repeating.
The apartment building changes before your eyes.
The neighbors start acting strangely.
And some things are better left unseen.

With every new floor, the nightmare becomes worse.

Welcome to “10th Floor: Elevator Anomalies” — an atmospheric psychological survival horror inspired by modern anomaly and observation horror games.

Explore the dark corridors of a decaying post-Soviet apartment building while carefully searching for anomalies. Some changes are obvious: disturbing creatures, terrifying silhouettes, impossible spaces, or blood-covered walls. Others are subtle. A missing object. A strange sound. A door that was never there before.

Your survival depends on noticing every detail.

On each floor, you must decide whether an anomaly is present or not. Make the wrong choice, and you’ll be sent back to the first floor. Some entities won’t even give you a second chance.

As you progress higher, reality itself starts to collapse. Hallways stretch endlessly into darkness. Stairwells twist unnaturally. Whispers echo through the building. Children laugh somewhere in the distance. Behind apartment doors, horrifying events unfold in the shadows.

And sometimes… someone else enters the elevator with you.

Throughout your journey, you will encounter terrifying residents of the anomaly:
a mysterious old woman, hooded strangers, aggressive neighbors, ghosts, strange homeless men, and entities hiding within the darkness of the apartment block.

But the scariest part is this:

Not everything is an anomaly.

Sometimes you’ll meet an ordinary neighbor.
Sometimes a drunk man in the hallway.
Sometimes a teenager drawing graffiti on the walls.
And sometimes a harmless old lady smiling at you in silence.

Or maybe not harmless at all.

The deeper you go, the harder it becomes to separate reality from nightmare.

The game combines oppressive atmosphere, psychological tension, exploration, survival horror elements, and constant paranoia. Even the familiar Soviet apartment building slowly transforms into a living trap.

Can you survive long enough to reach the mysterious 10th floor?

Or will the elevator trap you forever?

GAME FEATURES

• Atmospheric first-person psychological horror
• Search for anomalies and investigate every floor carefully
• Dark post-Soviet apartment building setting
• Random events and terrifying entities
• Tense and immersive horror gameplay
• Disturbing liminal spaces and spatial distortions
• Multiple anomaly types: visual, audio, and deadly encounters
• Survival horror and chase sequences
• High replayability through randomized events
• Inspired by modern indie horror and anomaly games

Solve every anomaly and reach the mysterious 10th floor… if you can.
data.description_short: A post-Soviet psychological survival horror about anomalies in a scary elevator

Rust Truck: Wasteland Delivery is the coolest 2D cargo truck simulator of apocalypse games! From the creators of the best trucker games, get ready for a completely new survival driving experience in this real trucker game.

Drive everything! From an old rusty tractor, a mini truck and a pickup truck, to a massive big rig or a heavy multi-axle semi-truck! Listen to your engine! Black smoke means you are pushing it too hard. Use the manual gearbox wisely! Switch between gears to climb steep hills without overheating the engine. Keep the cargo loading height in mind so you don't flip over. If your lorry flips or gets trapped, press the Towing button for a rescue.

📦 Extreme Cargo Transport
Transport vital survival goods: wooden crates, heavy fuel barrels, construction materials, and dangerous radioactive loads. Physics matters! It’s a real truck driver simulator – If you drive too fast over bumps or take a steep hill, your cargo will fall out, and you will fail the mission.

data.name: Arrow Pro 3D
data.description_full:
Welcome to Arrow Pro 3D, a relaxing 3D cube puzzle game where observation, timing, and planning come together.
Rotate the 3D cube, release arrows, and clear the board one move at a time. In this arrow puzzle 3D experience, every move matters. As you progress, each puzzle becomes more complex and rewards careful thinking, spatial awareness, and smart sequencing.
The controls are simple to understand, while the layouts continue to encourage deeper thinking throughout every level.

A fully rotatable 3D puzzle environment
Arrow Pro 3D takes place on an interactive three-dimensional cube. Unlike flat puzzle games, every face of the cube contributes to the solution. At times, the answer may be on the opposite side, requiring rotation and observation from different angles.

Players can rotate the cube freely, zoom in to inspect details, and study each surface before choosing the next move. This freedom supports thoughtful planning throughout every 3D puzzle.

Release arrows and clear surfaces
The core mechanic focuses on releasing arrows in the correct order. Tap an arrow to activate it, and it will travel forward along its direction, removing other arrows encountered along the path.
Some arrows travel short distances, while others move across larger areas. Understanding how arrows interact allows multiple elements to be removed efficiently. Careful sequencing often creates satisfying chain reactions that clear large sections of the cube in an arrow 3D escape style challenge.

Hundreds of handcrafted puzzles
Arrow Pro 3D contains a wide collection of handcrafted cube puzzles designed to maintain interest over time. Early challenges introduce fundamental behavior and basic movement patterns. As progress continues, layouts expand and require stronger observation and structured planning.
Players will encounter:
- Beginner-friendly compact cube layouts
- Medium difficulty spatial arrangements
- Large cube structures requiring careful reasoning
- Multi-stage solutions that reward planning and patience
Each layout presents a different arrangement that supports flexible thinking and encourages experimentation in arrow puzzle 3D gameplay.

Smooth and relaxing interactions
The overall experience focuses on steady pacing and visual clarity. Arrows glide across the 3D cube surfaces in a fluid motion. As elements disappear gradually, the cube becomes less crowded, creating a consistent visual rhythm.
A minimalist visual approach keeps attention on puzzle solving while maintaining readability during longer play sessions. Subtle animations provide visual feedback without distraction.

Develop thinking skills naturally
Arrow Pro 3D offers a structured way to exercise reasoning skills while maintaining a calm environment.
Regular play supports:
- Spatial awareness
- Logical reasoning
- Planning ability
- Pattern recognition
- Problem-solving confidence

Minimal, glowing, and satisfying — visual and audio feedback tuned for that perfect "aaah" moment.

Perfect for a quick, satisfying break — or a deep arcade session.
Five minutes turns into "just one more stage" before you know it.

data.name: Piggy Escape
data.description_full:
🐷 Screw Rescue — Match Two, Set Piggy Free! 🐷

Poor little piggy is trapped behind metal plates. Each plate is held in place by two screws. Your mission? Remove every screw and let the pig run free!

🎨 Match the Colors
Tap two screws of the same color, and they disappear together. Get the colors right, and the plates start falling apart. Get it wrong? Those screws stay stuck.

📦 5 Slots for Screws
Under the plates, there are 5 storage slots. When you tap a screw, it moves down into an empty slot, waiting for its matching partner. But if all 5 slots fill up with mismatched screws… you’re stuck. You’ll need to plan carefully and clear pairs before the slots overflow.

🧠 Trickier Every Level
At first, it’s simple — a few plates, clear colors. But as you progress, more colors appear, and the metal plates twist into crazy shapes. Some screws hide behind others. You’ll need sharp eyes and quick thinking to keep the slots from jamming.

⏱️ Race to Save the Pig
No timer, but you can compete with friends — who can rescue the piggy the fastest?

Ready to pull those screws and free the squealing hero? Start matching and save the pig! 🐽🔴🔵🟡🟢💥

data.name: Tile Travel - Classic Puzzle
data.description_full:
🧩 Game Introduction
*Tile Travel - Classic Puzzle* returns to the essence of match-3 games, offering you a pure, stress-relieving, and strategic journey right at your fingertips.
Here, there are no complicated extra rules—only layers of stacked tiles waiting for you to organize. Your objective is simple: find three identical tiles from the stack and tap them into the collection slots above to clear them, all before the limited slots become full.
The crisp sound of every successful match, and the sense of mental clarity that comes from clearing the entire board, form the core of this game's enjoyable experience. It serves as both a test of your powers of observation and a mental workout that allows you to calm your mind and fully immerse yourself in the challenge.

---
🎮 How to Play
- **Collect Tiles:** Tap a tile to move it into the collection slots located at the top of the screen. You must tap three tiles with identical patterns in succession to complete a match and clear them.
- **Manage Slots:** The collection slots can hold a maximum of 7 tiles at any one time. If the 7th tile is placed into the slots and there are still no three identical tiles available to match, the game ends. Therefore, carefully planning the order in which you tap is the key to victory.
- **Observe the Stack:** Tiles on lower layers may be hidden beneath those on upper layers. You must tap the upper tiles first to reveal the ones underneath. Consequently, identifying the optimal moves from the currently available tiles is the game's central challenge.
- **Patience is Key:** There is no time limit in this game. If you find yourself stuck, take a moment to carefully observe the board or use the Hint feature. Patience is often far more important than speed.
- **Use Boosters:** When you encounter a difficult situation, you can use boosters such as "Shuffle" or "Undo" to help break the deadlock.

---
✨ Game Features
🧠 **Massive Levels, Progressive Difficulty**
The game features a vast number of levels with a difficulty curve designed to ease you in gradually. From relaxing, beginner-friendly layouts to complex, overlapping, and highly challenging stacks in the later stages, you will always find a level that suits your current mood and skill level. Whether you want to relax for a few minutes during your commute or tackle brain-teasing puzzles in your leisure time, this game has something for everyone. 🌿 A Relaxing and Stress-Free Audiovisual Atmosphere
- Visual Style: The interface features soft, crisp colors and intuitive patterns that are easy to distinguish, ensuring that even extended gameplay won't cause visual fatigue. The game board is clean and uncluttered, free from any distracting elements.
🎯 No Internet Required—Play Anytime, Anywhere
The game offers a complete offline experience. Once downloaded, you can play through all unlocked levels without needing an internet connection. Whether you're on the subway, on a plane, or in an area with poor signal coverage, the joy of puzzle-solving is always at your fingertips.

---
✅ Key Highlights
"Tap to trigger, match three to clear. The simplest way to awaken the pure joy of strategic thinking."
*Tile Travel - Classic Puzzle* is a match-3 puzzle game that returns to the classics while eschewing unnecessary bloat. It strips away all non-essential content, retaining only the most engaging tile-matching and strategic planning gameplay. With a vast array of levels, a gentle difficulty curve, and a soothing audiovisual presentation, it serves as the ideal companion for exercising your brain and unwinding during your spare moments.
Open the game, tap that first tile, and embark on your puzzle-solving journey! 🧩
Finally, we hope you enjoy this game. If you have any thoughts or suggestions, please feel free to contact us.

data.name: Word Solitaire Go
data.description_full:
Word Solitaire Go is a refined word puzzle that blends the familiar structure of classic solitaire with the challenge of organizing meaning. Instead of numbers and suits, you work with complete word cards and group cards, turning a scattered table into a clear solution through thoughtful play.

How to Play
Every level begins with a partially revealed layout. You first establish the foundation by placing group cards, then draw new word cards into play and commit them to the right sets. Each placement shapes the board, opening some possibilities while quietly limiting others.
With a limited number of moves available, timing matters as much as correctness.

Strategy Over Speed

Gradually evolving difficulty without sudden spikes
Clean, focused presentation designed for calm play

Each session feels complete on its own, offering a clear beginning, rising tension, and a satisfying resolution. Over time, patterns become clearer, decisions sharper, and progress more rewarding.

Word Solitaire Go is calm on the surface, but deeply engaging once you lean in. It’s a game for players who enjoy focus, structure, and the quiet satisfaction of making everything fit.

- Study the maze grid and look for pieces with a clear exit path.
- Tap to release a piece when its path is open.
- Clear blocking pieces to unlock new routes.
- Plan your sequence to support your defense.
- Protect your treasure and complete the puzzle.

Each level is easy to understand, but solving the board efficiently takes focus, logic, and a good sense of timing.

Why You’ll Enjoy Arcane Maze
A Clean Logic Puzzle Experience
No complicated controls. No unnecessary pressure. Just observe, plan, and clear the maze step by step.

A Fresh Defense Puzzle Twist
Every move contributes to the battle. Your puzzle-solving decisions become part of your defense strategy.

Calm and Strategic Gameplay
There is no need to rush. Take your time, study the enemy path, and choose the smartest clearing order.

Satisfying Board Clearing
Feel the reward of turning a crowded maze into a clean, empty board. Each cleared piece brings you closer to victory.

Simple Visuals, Clear Decisions
The minimalist design keeps your attention on the puzzle, the maze, and the defense choices that matter.

Many Handcrafted Levels
Explore a wide range of maze layouts designed to test spatial thinking, planning, and problem-solving skills.

A Puzzle Game About Order, Timing, and Strategy
The satisfaction comes from seeing the whole board gradually make sense. A blocked path becomes open. A messy maze becomes organized. A risky defense becomes stable because of one smart move.

In Arcane Maze - Defense Puzzle, every level is a small strategic challenge: clear the maze, release the magic pieces, stop the minions, and protect the treasure.

data.name: Escape from ChungaChanga
data.description_full:
Escape from ChungaChanga is a crazy survival horror game filled with puzzles, escape mechanics, absurd humor, memes, and tons of ridiculous situations!

After a mysterious shipwreck, you find yourself stranded on a remote deserted island lost somewhere in the middle of the ocean. No connection. No rescue. Only dense jungles, strange totems, abandoned huts, and the constant feeling that someone is watching you.

And very soon, you realize — you are not alone on this island.

ChungaChanga lives here — a bizarre island native with a creepy smile, huge eyes, and completely unpredictable behavior. Sometimes he seems friendly, sometimes extremely dangerous, and sometimes he is simply doing the most absurd things imaginable. You never know what he will do next: watch a stone TV, dance around a campfire, or search for food inside an ancient refrigerator…

Now your goal is to survive and find a way to escape the island.

But escaping will not be easy. The island is full of secrets, traps, strange mechanisms, and unexpected events. To survive, you will need to explore the island, search for useful items, solve puzzles, and invent the weirdest escape methods possible.

You can try building a raft from random materials and risk sailing into the open ocean. You can light a giant signal fire and hope someone notices you. In some situations, you will need to use the environment in completely insane ways — like turning a palm tree into a giant slingshot or setting clever traps for ChungaChanga.

Sometimes your only chance of survival is to stun the island native, distract him, or hide in the most unexpected places. But even when your plan seems perfect, everything can go terribly wrong in seconds.

Every escape attempt becomes its own crazy story filled with unexpected events, strange dialogues, and hilarious moments. Horror constantly mixes with absurd comedy, and tense situations can instantly turn into pure meme chaos.

But the strangest part begins when you realize… maybe escaping is not necessary at all.

As time passes, you can get to know ChungaChanga better. It turns out he is not only scaring unwanted visitors — he also loves playing checkers, dancing by the fire, hunting, and doing all sorts of weird activities. Instead of escaping, you can try becoming his friend and unlock completely different story paths.

Some endings turn into total comedic madness. In one ending you become ChungaChanga’s best friend, in another you stay on the island forever, and in some situations the story becomes so absurd that it is impossible to explain with words.

Every decision changes the story. Some actions unlock new escape methods, others reveal secret scenes, while certain choices lead to completely unexpected endings. The game is packed with hidden details, easter eggs, and bizarre interactions you can discover again and again.

If you enjoy:
survival horror games, escape adventures, action-adventure games, meme humor, trash comedy, absurd situations, puzzles, and unusual endings — then Escape from ChungaChanga is exactly what you need!

Game Features:

- Survival horror on a deserted island;
- Puzzle solving and item searching;
- Multiple escape methods;
- Multiple playthroughs without escaping;
- Funny and absurd situations;
- Unexpected endings;
- Island exploration and secret locations;
- Meme humor and trash comedy;
- Weird characters;
- Jump scares and creepy events;
- Ridiculous but effective survival methods.

A new game from the developers of “Escape from Vlogger: Runaway” featuring Holy Baam!

Can you escape this insane island?
Or will ChungaChanga become your new best friend forever?

data.name: Arrow Out - Tap and Go
data.description_full:
Looking for relaxing game. Step into world of order and logic with Arrow Out - Tap and Go, the ultimate minimalist arrow escape puzzle. Designed to refresh your mind while challenging your brain, this game offers serene yet stimulating experience for players who love strategy without the stress.

Your mission is simple: Clear the grid by guiding every arrow out. But be careful—one wrong move leads to bad ending. Plan your sequence, navigate tight spaces, and find the satisfying flow of a perfectly executed escape.

Why You’ll Love This Puzzle
- Minimalist Zen: A clean, distraction-free interface that lets you focus entirely on the logic of the arrows.
- Play at Your Pace: No ticking clocks or high-pressure timers. Take your time to find the right path.

CORE GAMEPLAY
- Intuitive Controls: Simple tap-to-move mechanics that feel smooth and responsive.
- Heart System: Every tap counts! Avoid blocked paths to keep your hearts intact and finish with a perfect score.
- Smart Hints: Stuck in a tight spot? Use a hint to reveal the next safe move and keep your momentum.
- Gradual Mastery: Easy to learn, but challenging to master as the arrow configurations become more intricate.
- Brain-Boosting Strategy: Enhance your spatial awareness and forward-thinking as levels grow in complexity.

data.name: Amaze Rush 3D
data.description_full:
Imagine a 3D cube covered in arrows. Some point straight ahead. Others twist around corners — stretching across two or even three faces. Your job? Tap each arrow in the right direction to make it fly off the cube. Sounds simple? Wait until they start crossing paths.

🎯 How It Works
Every arrow has a direction — up, down, left, right, or a bendy path that wraps around the cube. You need to tap an arrow so it follows its direction and leaves the cube cleanly. But here’s the catch: arrows must not crash into each other. A wrong tap could send two arrows straight into a collision!

🔄 Inspect Every Angle
The cube is fully rotatable. Drag to spin it, zoom in to see the tricky corners, and study how arrows connect across faces. Some arrows hide their tails on the other side. Only by looking from every angle can you figure out the right order.

🧠 Plan Your Taps
It’s not just about tapping fast. You have to think ahead — which arrow should go first? Which one will block another if you tap too early? The arrows are interlocked like a puzzle knot. Solve the sequence and watch them all fly away.

🧩 More Than Just a Cube
As you progress, the arrows get crazier — longer paths, tighter turns, and more overlapping routes. Each level is a new brain‑teaser that makes you twist your thinking along with the cube.

Ready to twist, tap, and untangle? Grab the cube and let the arrows find their way home! 🔄➡️⬆️⬇️🔲
data.description_short: Click the arrows to make them leave the cube.

Fighter planes streak across the sky, naval vessels cut through open water, and armored vehicles advance across the ground in the middle of large-scale battles. Your role is to stay calm under pressure, follow the movement of each target, and release a perfectly timed shot that turns the tide of battle.

Precision Guns allow you to eliminate ground vehicles and armored units with deadly accuracy. Each weapon can be upgraded to increase its damage, bullet speed, rate of fire, and overall war shooting power. The more you develop your arsenal, the more dominant your battlefield performance becomes.

Your battles will take place across diverse war operations inspired by different theaters of conflict: Warsaw, Gibraltar, Pearl Harbor and more. Climb the competitive war leagues and prove yourself against players worldwide. data.name: Word Jigsort – Associations

Are you looking for an exciting new puzzle that mixes the fun of brain teasers with the work of word associations, but also has some Solitare and puzzle aspects mixed in? Merge puzzle pieces to reveal pictures that match the categories, and build your vocabulary in the process as you work to clear the board in the right order.
