MAKE LOGICAL CONNECTIONS AND SOLVE

Each level you’ll be dealt a variety of cards, the number of which goes up the further you progress. Your job is to match and merge the cards that are part of the same image, thus connecting them with one of the categories shown. But watch out, you’ll need to make those associations in the right order so as to best clear the game field and free up space for the remaining pieces to appear. This relaxing game is both fun and stimulating to play, and with help like the Highlight and Shuffle boosts available you’re sure to never get stuck, at least for too long.

Connect and make associations – as you pick though the available puzzle pieces, try and puzzle out which categories they might belong to, so as to best optimize your use of the game board. Pieces that have been correctly merged will shrink down but still take up space, so when possible, make those word associations! You might even find your vocabulary growing in the process.

Relax while playing – while this brain teaser is heavy on the word puzzle goodness, that doesn’t mean it has to be boring or difficult to play! Turn on the music and haptics if that’s your vibe or play silently, and take as long as you want thinking through your various moves as there’s no countdown clock – you can also restart a level as much as you want to get it just right.

data.name: NTE: Neverness to Everness
data.description_full:
NTE is a supernatural open-world RPG developed by Hotta Studio. The story begins in the city of Hethereau, where you play as its first "unlicensed" Anomaly Hunter. You'll join the crew at Eibon, a rundown antique shop that keeps the lights on by taking Anomaly commissions from anyone willing to pay. Alongside a diverse cast of extraordinary companions, you'll unravel urban mysteries, ride out adventures full of laughs and heartbreak, and write your own stories in the neon-lit streets.

◆ Strange City, Strange Adventures

Welcome to the first stop in your appraisal career—Hethereau, a sprawling and vibrant metropolis!

In the crowded halls of the Bureau of Anomaly Control, hopeful Oddities queue up for resident permits, while over at the train station, an Esper commuter snaps his fingers to clean his work suit on the fly. Down one block, a chaotic chase after Danzaburou is spiraling out of control; while across the street, a vacationing silver-gloved Butler is shooting the breeze with the owner of a second-hand electronics shop. Everywhere you look, there's no shortage of intriguingly "abnormal" scenes.

Want to dive deeper into a world where humans and the supernatural coexist? Start your journey in Hethereau to see it for yourself. The lively and quirky daily life here is a grand adventure in itself.

◆ Interesting Stories, Lighthearted Connections

Today's Top Story: Rumors are swirling about a mysterious pawnshop that only appears on the night of the full moon. What would you trade for a wish?

◆ Encounters and Bonds

Explore hidden shops tucked away in back alleys and meet their enigmatic owners, along with absurdly overpowered bodyguards, "jack-of-all-trades" robotic butlers, troublemakers who can't help finding problems, and TV-headed repairmen with some very curious eating habits.

As part of the Eibon crew, you'll never be short on energetic companions for the road ahead.

Expand your social circle starting from the bustling Hankaku Street! Meet members from different factions and add them as "Bagel" friends!

From the tight-knit neighborhood of street shops to the city's unique hunter organizations, countless side stories await—ready for you to make friends and forge bonds across every corner of Hethereau.

◆ Customize Your Urban Lifestyle

Explore the city on your own terms—stick to familiar routines or shake things up.

Customize your ride and tear through the city streets, or hop on the Ghost Train to cut through Anomaly space and arrive in a flash.

In your downtime, swing by the old shops on Hankaku Street to browse their secret seasonal stock, or buy a cozy little home and deck it out to your liking.

Go at your own pace, follow your instincts, and let Hethereau reward you with colorful days worth remembering.

data.name: Line Tap Go
data.description_full:
Line Tap Go is a laid-back logic puzzle game that turns simple tapping operations into fun and fulfilling brain challenges. The core gameplay is easy to grasp: locate valid free paths, tap lines in the correct order, and watch the intricate line maze gradually fade into a blank and tidy grid. Solve each maze level by clearing lines, and immerse yourself in a smooth, calming gaming experience that keeps your brain active without feeling fatigued.

Want to exercise your brain in a casual, pressure-free way? This unique line puzzle game helps you release daily stress, block out trivial distractions, and polish your logical judgment and spatial imagination. It serves as a perfect relaxing daily routine, letting you unwind and focus at your own pace. Every completed level brings a refreshing mental adjustment and a small, delightful sense of accomplishment.

How to Play Line Tap Go

- This innovative tap-to-clear puzzle features grids filled with lines facing various directions, and your ultimate goal is to fully clear the entire maze grid.
- To beat each level, you need to figure out accessible paths first. A line can only be removed when its forward route is completely unblocked by other lines. Take your time to observe and plan your tapping strategy before making a move.
- Tap valid lines one by one to remove them from the grid, which will unlock more movable space for remaining lines and help you advance smoothly.
- Avoid invalid tapping! Tapping any line with a blocked path will cost you one life. Each level has limited lives, but you can always reset your thinking and retry the level freely with no time pressure.
- Stuck on a tricky puzzle stage? Use the practical hint function to get prompts for removable lines and keep your puzzle-solving progress going.
- Arrange your tapping sequence reasonably, clear all lines on the grid, and relish the satisfying moment when the entire maze is completely solved.

Why You’ll Love Line Tap Go

- ✔ Minimalist puzzle design with intuitive rules and rich strategic depth — friendly for beginners and addictive for puzzle pros.
- ✔ Dozens of carefully handmade puzzle levels, with progressive difficulty that brings continuous fresh challenges.
- ✔ Fun daily and monthly challenge missions, allowing you to collect exclusive trophies and enrich your gaming experience.
- ✔ Practical hint system to help you get out of bottlenecks and maintain a smooth gaming flow.
- ✔ Zero timer and no rush mechanics — pure casual relaxation, suitable for fragmented time entertainment.
- ✔ Neat and comfortable visual style paired with fluent animations, creating a focused and pleasant puzzle-solving atmosphere.

Download Line Tap Go now! Clear line mazes, train your brain logic, and experience the perfect balance of focused thinking and soothing relaxation in every puzzle level.

data.name: Arrows Go: Arrow Escape Puzzle
data.description_full:
Go Arrows Go is a fun and relaxing puzzle game that keeps your brain engaged without feeling stressful.

In Relaxed mode, your goal is simple: find the arrow that can move out freely, tap it away, and open space for the next one. As the board fills up, every move matters more, and the wrong tap can cost a heart, so a little planning goes a long way. Want tougher untimed solves? Jump into Challenge mode with the same hearts-and-hints flow as Relaxed, but with harder grids organized into themed city packs. Use pinch-to-zoom + pan on the biggest layouts so you can scan the board comfortably.

Want more intensity? Jump into Timed mode and race the clock. Pick a collection (grid size), solve a random board as fast as you can, and climb daily, weekly, and all-time leaderboards. Your final time includes mistake penalties, so speed and accuracy both count.

Whether you want a quick mental break or a competitive challenge, Go Arrows Go is easy to pick up and satisfying to master. The clean minimalist design, smooth controls, rewarding logic gameplay, in‑app Guide, and Collection replay make it a great fit for players who enjoy clever arrow/path puzzles across calm, collectible, and competitive play styles.

How it works:
• Look for an arrow with a clear path to the board edge
• Tap arrows in the right order to open new routes
• Avoid blocked taps as mistakes cost hearts in Relaxed and Challenge (+ refill options when you’re out of hearts)
• Use hints when you need a little help (they trace a safe move and escape path)
• Clear every arrow to finish the level

Challenge mode spotlight:
• Harder grids in city collections, still untimed with hearts + hints
• Pinch + pan for comfortable navigation on very large puzzles

Timed mode highlights:
• Race the clock on random boards sized by grid/collection
• Mistakes add time penalties, so precision matters
• Daily, weekly, and all‑time leaderboards
• Personal best tracking by collection/grid size

Why you'll love Go Arrows Go:
• Easy to learn, satisfying logic you can play offline anytime
• Three ways to play: Relaxed, Challenge, and Timed
• Minimalist visuals with optional Rainbow arrows (classic monochrome still available in Settings)
• Sound, haptics, and Dark mode you can tailor to your vibe
• Optional push notifications: streak‑risk reminders and Top 3 / daily leaderboard‑style rank alerts (fully optional)
• Streak goals plus badge-style collection milestones across grid sizes

data.name: Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort
data.description_full:
Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort is a relaxing puzzle with a fresh conveyor twist, blending colorful sorting, smart crate filling, and smooth loop-based logic into a calm but satisfying experience.

🎮 In Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort, you sort colorful cubes and cards into matching crates in a relaxing conveyor loop puzzle with no timers and no rush. Just pure color sort gameplay that clears your mind while you clear the board. If you love sorting games with unique conveyor mechanics and cozy puzzle vibes, this is your perfect match.

🌀 Sorting in Motion

This is more than a simple color sort. The loop keeps everything moving, so timing, order, and space management matter just as much as matching the right colors.

🏆 One Conveyor Loop, One Goal

In Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort, every move is about keeping the conveyor flowing, matching colors efficiently, and making smart use of limited space.

• Tap to send cubes onto the conveyor and set the loop in motion.
• As cubes travel around the belt, they wait for the right crate to open up.
• Gather four cubes of the same color in one crate to combine them into a complete piece.

Keep the Loop Clear

• Watch the conveyor capacity carefully, because only a limited number of cube groups can stay on the loop at once.
• If the conveyor fills up and no useful moves remain, the round comes to an end.
• Every open slot can change your next move, so keeping space available is part of the puzzle itself.
• In some levels, only the top color is visible at first, while the cubes below stay hidden until they are revealed one by one.
• This hidden-color twist makes every early move more important, because one choice can affect which colors appear next.

Plan your moves, control the flow, and enjoy the satisfaction of every perfect merge.

⚡ Tools to Keep the Loop Moving

When the conveyor gets crowded, the right tool can help you fix mistakes, reopen space, and keep your sorting plan alive.

• Undo – Take the card on the conveyor back to the box and undo your last move. It’s perfect for correcting a rushed decision before it causes bigger problems.

• Shuffle – Select a plank and shuffle the color cubes inside. Use it to reset a tricky arrangement and open up new matching possibilities.

• Extra – Add 2 more capacity slots when you need more room. It gives you valuable breathing space when the loop gets tight and every open spot matters.

🎁 More Levels, More Rewards

Every completed level gives you something to look forward to. Win more levels to earn rewards, collect level gifts, and unlock limited-time perks like 30-minute unlimited lives that let you keep playing with fewer interruptions.

👍 Why You’ll Love It

• A fresh conveyor loop twist that makes every sort feel more dynamic.
• Clean, low-randomness puzzle play where smart planning pays off.
• Great for a quick break, with enough depth to keep longer sessions rewarding.
• Offline-friendly gameplay that fits wherever you want to play.
• A great match for fans of color sorting, card puzzles, and calm brain games.

Ready to clear the loop and master the flow? Start Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort now and enjoy a fresh sorting puzzle built around calm strategy and satisfying progress.

Clear the Loop. Match the Card. Sort the Cube.

data.name: Arrow To Rich

One wrong order and a path becomes blocked. You must carefully plan ahead, visualize movements, and find the exact sequence that empties the board safely.
As you progress, puzzles grow more complex with tighter clusters and overlapping paths, training your spatial reasoning and foresight. There are no timers, no lives, and no pressure — just peaceful, rewarding logic.

Hundreds of handcrafted levels with smoothly increasing difficulty
Beautiful minimalist design with soft colors and clean interface
Unlimited retries and pause anytime for stress-free play
Smart hint system to gently guide you when stuck
Offline mode, perfect for travel or quiet moments
Satisfying “perfect clear” achievements for mastering levels without mistakes

Who Is It For?
Arrow To Rich is ideal for fans of Flow Free, sliding block puzzles, or any game that rewards patience and pattern recognition. Whether you’re a student sharpening focus, a professional needing a mental break, or a casual player seeking relaxing “aha!” moments, this game delivers quiet satisfaction.
No flashy stories or distractions — just pure puzzle joy. Every cleared grid brings a peaceful sense of accomplishment as the last arrow slides away, leaving a perfectly empty board.
Start with simple levels to learn the flow, then tackle advanced grids that demand deeper planning. With practice, you’ll spot elegant solutions faster and feel your logical skills improve.

data.name: Drive Car Beyond Desert Game
data.description_full:
Drive Beyond: Desert Survival – The Ultimate Post-Apocalyptic Engineering Challenge
The world has stalled. Your engine is just getting started.

Welcome to the scorching remains of civilization. In Drive Beyond, you aren’t just a survivor; you are a mechanic, a scavenger, and a warrior. Stranded in an infinite expanse of sun-bleached sand and rusted metal, your only ticket to safety is a hollowed-out car chassis and your ability to find what’s missing.

The desert is beautiful, but it is a graveyard. Beneath the shifting dunes lie the remnants of the old world, guarded by the relentless, hungry dead. If you want to see the horizon, you’ll have to build your way there.

SYNOPSIS
You wake up in a derelict garage with a simple realization: staying still is a death sentence. To escape the wasteland, you must explore dangerous territories to find car components, assemble a functional vehicle from scratch, and maintain it while fighting off hordes of zombies. Every mile gained is a triumph; every mechanical failure is a crisis.

CORE GAMEPLAY PILLARS
1. Hardcore Scavenging & Exploration
The desert is vast and unforgiving. Explore abandoned gas stations, ransacked military outposts, and decaying towns.

Find the Parts: You won’t just find a "car." You’ll find a rusted alternator, a cracked radiator, and mismatched tires.

High-Stakes Looting: The best parts are often in the most infested areas. Do you risk entering a dark basement for a high-performance turbocharger?

2. The Assembly Mechanic
Experience a deep, tactile vehicle construction system.

Build It Piece by Piece: Install the engine, wire the battery, bolt on the doors, and ensure the cooling system can handle the desert heat.

Customize for Survival: Add reinforced bumpers to ram through zombie blockades, or roof racks to carry extra fuel for long-distance treks.

Physics-Based Performance: Every part you add affects the weight, handling, and fuel consumption of your ride.

3. Brutal Zombie Combat
The undead aren’t just obstacles; they are a constant pressure.

Vehicular Carnage: Use your car as a 2-ton weapon. Mow down the horde, but be careful—hitting too many zombies will damage your bodywork and engine.

On-Foot Defense: When you’re out scavenging, it’s just you and whatever scrap metal you’ve sharpened into a blade. Keep your distance and keep your head on a swivel.

4. Survival Strategy
Fuel is Gold: Managing your gasoline is the difference between reaching a safe zone and being stranded in the dark.

Thermal Management: The desert sun is brutal. Keep your car’s fluids topped off, or watch your engine explode in a cloud of steam.

Permadeath Elements: Every decision counts. One wrong turn into a sandstorm or a poorly timed mechanical failure can end your run.

WHY PLAY DRIVE BEYOND?
Unlike standard driving games, Drive Beyond focuses on the relationship between a driver and their machine. You will feel every rattle of the engine and every gear shift because you were the one who put it together. It combines the tension of survival horror with the satisfaction of a simulation-grade mechanical builder.

The dunes are calling, and the dead are following. Will you build a masterpiece of survival, or will you become just another skeleton in the sand?

TECHNICAL HIGHLIGHTS
Dynamic Weather: Navigate through blinding sandstorms that affect visibility and engine performance.

Realistic Damage Model: Parts can break, overheat, or be torn off by zombies.

Immersive Soundscape: From the click of a socket wrench to the guttural moan of a distant horde.

ARE YOU READY TO DRIVE CAR BEYOND Desert? Download now and start your assembly.
data.description_short: Scavenge parts, build your ride, and crush zombies. Try to escape the wasteland.

data.name: Dino Eternal
data.description_full:
A bond that even death couldn't break.

The world has already ended after a massive meteor wiped everything out. Dino Eternal is a pixel-art tower defense survival game where your story is just getting started.

You play as the spirit of a young dinosaur who refuses to move on. Even in the afterlife, your only goal is to protect your mother’s resting place from the demons trying to reach her. It’s a tragic, beautiful stand in a world that has gone quiet.

How to play
Defend her at all costs: You are the final line of defense. Use your spirit powers to fight back against waves of demons. They aren't just mindless monsters; they are shadows drawn to your mother’s soul.

You aren't alone: You can call on the spirits of other fallen dinosaurs to help you. Each one has a specific role, so you’ll need to think fast and place them strategically to hold back the horde.

The waves never stop: As time goes on, the demons get faster and more aggressive. It’s all about how long you can hold out. There is no retreat and no place to hide.

Classic retro vibes: The game features beautiful, hand-crafted pixel art that captures the lonely but peaceful atmosphere of the prehistoric afterlife.

The goal is simple
There is no "winning" in a world that’s already gone. This is about loyalty, courage, and how long you can protect the person who meant everything to you.

How many nights can you keep the shadows away?

data.name: Water Loop Puzzle
data.description_full:
Water Loop Puzzle is a relaxing water sort puzzle that gives classic color sorting a fresh loop conveyor twist. Instead of pouring directly from one tube to another, send the top water layer onto a moving conveyor and choose the right place for it. Match colors, organize the tubes, and complete each level with smart moves.

🌊 A FRESH TAKE ON WATER SORT
The goal is easy to understand: sort the colors until each tube contains only one color. The difference is how you get there.
Tap a tube to move its top layer onto the conveyor. Watch it travel around the board, then place it into a matching tube or an empty space. Because every move joins the loop flow, timing and planning become part of the challenge.

🔄 HOW TO PLAY
• Tap a tube to select the top layer
• Send the layer onto the moving conveyor
• Follow its path around the board
• Place it with the same color or in an empty tube
• Keep sorting until every tube is completed

Simple rules make Water Loop Puzzle easy to pick up, while the moving loop system adds more strategy than a traditional sorting game.

🧠 PLAN, MATCH, AND SOLVE
A good move is not only about finding the same color. You also need to think about space, order, and what your next move will reveal.
Use empty tubes wisely. Avoid blocking colors you may need later. Plan a few moves ahead and keep the board flexible as the level develops.
As you progress, new layouts introduce more tubes, more colors, and increasingly interesting logic puzzle situations. The objective stays familiar, but each board gives you a different sorting problem to solve.

✨ WHY YOU’LL ENJOY IT
• A fresh twist on classic water sort gameplay
• Satisfying color sort and color matching mechanics
• A moving conveyor that changes how each move works
• Simple controls for quick and easy play
• Relaxing gameplay with thoughtful puzzle decisions
• Smooth movement, clear tubes, and vibrant colors
• Levels that gradually become more challenging

🎯 CLASSIC SORTING WITH A NEW LOOP FLOW
Fans of water sort games will recognize the satisfying goal of organizing colors into separate tubes. Water Loop Puzzle keeps that familiar foundation while adding movement through the conveyor system.
This makes the game feel different from a standard color sort puzzle. Instead of moving directly between two tubes, you work with a continuous flow and decide when and where each layer should be placed.
The result is a mix of color sorting, matching, timing, and logic. It is simple enough for a quick break, but the later levels give puzzle fans more room to plan and experiment.

💡 THINK AHEAD
When a level becomes tricky, slow down and look at the whole board. An empty tube can create space for several future moves. A good color match can open the next part of the puzzle. Choosing the right order can turn a crowded board into a clear path forward.
There is no single rhythm for every level. Learn the flow, build your own strategy, and find the sequence that works.
Ready to sort the colors?

Play Water Loop Puzzle and enjoy a satisfying water sorting game where classic tube puzzles meet a moving conveyor loop.
data.description_short: Relaxing water sort puzzle with color sorting and a moving conveyor loop.

🎯 Game Introduction
*Arrow Line: Flow Escape ASMR* is more than just a maze puzzle game; it is an immersive sensory meditation designed for both your mind and your ears. Here, logic meets art, and focus coexists with relaxation. You will step into a minimalist world composed of arrows, lines, and mysterious patterns, where every tap serves as a crucial step toward the exit. This isn't merely about finding a way out; it’s about navigating a chaotic forest of lines to identify the single pattern that stands out—the "odd one out"—to cut through the fog and guide the flow in the right direction. Once everything falls into place, soothing, ASMR-like sound effects will play a tranquil symphony of victory just for you.

🎮 Gameplay Overview
Each level presents a complex maze interwoven with arrows, geometric lines, and hidden patterns. Your objective isn't to move a character, but to use observation and deduction to tap the correct sequence of lines.
Think slowly and analyze precisely; the mazes are static yet intricate, putting your powers of observation and spatial reasoning to the test.
Levels range from simple grids of straight-line arrows to complex circular vortices and fractal tree-like structures.
Play anytime, anywhere—no Wi-Fi required!

---
✨ Game Features
🎨 Minimalist Aesthetics, Visually Soothing
- Pure Visual Style: Featuring soft neon hues, a dark background, and glowing lines, the design ensures a comfortable visual experience that prevents eye strain even during extended play sessions.
🧠 Innovative "Odd-One-Out" Training
- This is more than just puzzle-solving; it is a form of cognitive training. The game features scientifically designed "distractor" patterns that effectively hone your attention span, pattern recognition skills, and ability to filter out distractions.
🚇 Vast Levels & Daily Challenges
- Includes thousands of meticulously crafted levels—each a clever puzzle designed to provide a comprehensive workout for your brain.
- Daily "Anomaly Mazes": A unique maze generated every day, based on real-world traffic data or complex mathematical patterns. ---
✅ Key Highlights
“Find order amidst chaotic lines; escape the maze through the notes of ASMR.”
*Arrow Line: Flow Escape ASMR* masterfully blends the observational challenge of “spotting the difference” with the logical puzzle-solving of “building a path.” Wrapped in exquisite ASMR sound design, it creates an unprecedented experience of focused relaxation. Rather than offering an escape *from* reality, it provides a tranquil, logic-driven micro-universe that you can step into whenever you wish.
Whether you are a puzzle game enthusiast or simply seeking a mobile game to calm your mind and exercise your brain, you will find your own unique “flow moment” right here.
Download it now, put on your headphones, tap the first line, and let your thoughts—guided by the arrows—flow toward the exit. 🎧✨


Finally, we hope you enjoy the game! If you have any thoughts or suggestions, please feel free to contact us.

data.name: Colorever: Gem Art Puzzle
data.description_full:
Colorever: relax with sparkling gems and beautiful coloring art.

Every gem belongs somewhere. Tap a gem and watch the whole cluster glide home, one by one, until a bright gem art picture is complete. Easy for everyone, fun for all ages. No timers. No fail screens. No game over. Just you, the gems, and a calm little puzzle you can always solve.

WHY PLAYERS STAY

See the whole picture from the start. Nothing is hidden, nothing is guesswork. You always know where every gem is going, so the pleasure comes from planning the route, not from hunting for a secret. Colorever is a puzzle funny game you can play with your shoulders down.

HOW TO PLAY

Tap a gem, move a cluster. Tap one gem and every connected gem of the same color is picked up together, then flies to its matching space one gem at a time.
Read the board. Each space on the board already shows the color of the gem it is waiting for. Match gem to space and it locks into place with a satisfying click.
Use the tray. The tray holds gems you are not ready to place yet. Park a few, open up the board, then bring them back in when the space is free.
Finish the picture. Place the last gem and the full gem art scene lights up, ready for your gallery.

A GROWING GEM GALLERY

Hundreds of pixel art pictures to complete, from animals and food to flowers, cities and cozy little scenes, with fresh sets added regularly. Every picture you finish is saved to your gallery, so your collection of gems and gem art keeps growing as you play.

FEATURES

Relaxing by design. No countdown, no losing streak, no pressure. Play one puzzle on a coffee break or twenty in a row.
Always solvable. Every level has a solution, so getting stuck is temporary, never fatal.
Gentle learning curve. The first gem puzzles teach themselves. Later boards are wide, layered and genuinely worth thinking about.
Handy helpers. Add an extra tray space, undo a move, take a hint, or let a smart tap tidy up the easy gems for you.
Made to feel good. Crisp gems, glowing diamonds, soft sound and light haptics on every placement.
Play offline, anywhere. No connection needed. Pause mid puzzle and pick it up hours later, exactly where you left it.
For everyone. Simple enough for a first ever puzzle game, deep enough for players who like to plan three moves ahead.

FOR PLAYERS WHO LIKE

Relaxing puzzle games. Gem art and coloring pixel pictures. Gem, jewel and diamond puzzles. Calm brain games and quiet logic. Satisfying, oddly soothing placement games.

Take a breath. Tap a gem. Let the gem art shine.

data.name: Line to Jewels
data.description_full:

Each level is filled with stones and different objects that shape the path — some block the way, while others help create useful ricochets. Every stage is a small challenge. data.name: You Know: Associations
data.description_full:
You Know: Associations is a fast, competitive card game where every move matters. Match by colour or category, play smart power cards, build strong combinations, and outscore your opponents in a fun and rewarding card association experience. If you enjoy a card game with strategy and satisfying card connect mechanics, You Know: Associations is made for you.

In this multiplayer card game, you take turns matching cards by CATEGORY or COLOUR. It sounds simple, but every round is full of pressure, timing, and powerful combinations. Use Flip, Block, Take 2, Change Category, and Change Category & Take 4 to control the table and create major momentum swings. Whether you love a quick card game or a card connect challenge, this game keeps every round fresh.

FEATURES:
• Multiplayer card game for 4 players
• Easy-to-learn card association rules
• Match by category or colour
• Create smart combinations and chain powerful plays
• Enjoy strategic decisions in every turn
• Use special action cards to flip, block, stack, and change category
• Competitive coin rewards for top players
• Quick matches with strategic depth
• Resume your game if you return shortly after leaving

You Know: Associations combines the instant fun of a classic card game with strategic gameplay and satisfying card connect action. Every hand gives you new combinations to explore. Every round of card association challenges you to think ahead, manage risk, and hold the right cards for the perfect moment. If you like a card game that rewards smart choices, this is the card association game to download.

HOW TO PLAY

Play one card at a time by matching the top card on the discard pile. You can match by category or by colour. If you cannot play, draw a card. Power Cards let you reverse the turn order, skip the next player, or make them draw cards. Special Cards let you change the category or put even more pressure on your opponents.

Stacking adds even more excitement. When a Take 2 or Change Category & Take 4 card is played, the next player can answer with another penalty card instead of drawing. This creates bigger combinations and raises the total until someone cannot continue. That player takes all stacked cards and loses their turn. These high-pressure moments make every card game round more intense and strategic.

Win by playing all your cards or by finishing with the lowest score when the game ends. Base Cards are worth 5 points, Power Cards are worth 20, and Special Cards are worth 50. Strong card association strategy, careful combinations, and smart card connect decisions are the key to victory. Place in the top 2 to earn coins, build your balance, and join more matches.

If you are searching for a card game with card association strategy, clever combinations, and exciting card connect action, You Know: Associations delivers it all. Download now and enjoy a card game that is easy to start, fun to master, and packed with replay value.

data.name: Fire Clown Arena
data.description_full:
Dive into a vibrant and juicy fruit-matching adventure set in a magical, glowing space! Your task is simple and addictive: watch the order at the top of the screen and tap the exact fruits shown (grapes, cherries, plums, strawberries and more) as they float across the screen. Tap the correct one to earn +10 points instantly, and watch your score climb higher with every successful match.
Each level gives you a fresh order list - sometimes one fruit, sometimes multiples - and you have limited lives (three hearts) to complete it. Hit the wrong fruit and lose a life; lose all three and the round ends. But nail every tap perfectly, and you'll collect shiny badges that multiply your points (x2, x5, x10) - turning good runs into massive scores. The more orders you finish, the more exciting the garden becomes: sparkling effects, colorful explosions of fruit juice, and a satisfying glow when you complete the set.
The visuals are rich and inviting: deep red curtains, golden crowns, floating fruits against a dreamy background, and warm lighting that makes every tap feel rewarding. Intuitive one-tap controls keep things smooth and fun - no complicated moves, just quick reflexes and good timing.
Ideal for short bursts of play or longer sessions chasing bigger scores. Feel the rush of nailing a tough order, the joy of watching multipliers stack up, and the thrill of seeing your final score light up the screen with fireworks. Whether you're relaxing on the couch or waiting for a friend, this fruit-filled challenge keeps you coming back for more. Test your speed, sharpen your focus, and see how high you can score - the garden is waiting for your perfect performance!
data.description_short: Complete fruit challenges, win with perfect taps!

data.name: Mega Machines: Heavy Duty Sim

MEGA MACHINES is the ultimate heavy equipment simulator that lets you tackle massive construction, shipping, and earthmoving challenges. From filling trenches with massive wheel excavators to clearing rubble with heavy-duty wheel dozers, precision and power are your best tools in this immersive low-poly driving simulator.

• Dynamic Worksites: Complete challenging jobs across bustling city construction sites, deep mining quarries, and busy shipping docks.
• Realistic Physics Simulation: Feel the true weight, power, and momentum of heavy machinery as you dig dirt, lift cargo, haul ore, and crush rubble.
• Free Roam Sandbox Mode: Have fun testing out your favorite trucks and cranes with no limits, timers, or restrictions.

• Wheel Dozer: Trading standard crawler tracks for massive tires, it offers a unique blend of road speed and pushing capability to backfill trenches and clear debris fast.
• ShortBase Crane: A compact mobile crane sacrificing no heavy lifting capacity. Use incredible finesse to lift, place, and transport heavy cargo in tight spaces.

• Reach Stacker: Enter the high-stakes world of industrial logistics. Stack, sort, and load heavy shipping containers onto waiting transport trucks with pinpoint accuracy.

• Mining Loader: Designed for harsh quarry environments, this giant wheel loader scoops tons of solid rock in a single pass to load fleets of waiting dump trucks.

• Construction Crane: Towering above the worksite, operate complex winch and trolley systems to hoist massive steel beams and concrete perfectly into place while battling load sway.
• Crane Truck: Combining the speed of a heavy transport with a hydraulic boom. Secure its outriggers for delicate recovery operations and quick-lifting jobs across scattered sites.
• Portal Crane: Dominate the shipping dock on a massive rail system. Straddle lanes of traffic to seamlessly transfer heavy containers between railcars and truck trailers.

Download MEGA MACHINES today! Experience a top-tier low-poly construction simulator designed for precision, driving skill, and mechanical mastery. The ultimate heavy machine simulator awaits you.

data.name: Indian Dress Up: Bride Stylist
data.description_full:
Pick the perfect lehenga, layer on the jewels, and go head-to-head against rival stylists to claim the Lovely Bride crown. Indian Bride Dress Up Games puts you in full control of every bridal look, from the skincare routine all the way to the final bindi. Can you out-style the competition?

This is a dress up Indian wedding experience built around real fashion choices. Every outfit, every accessory, and every makeup detail you pick feeds into a live competition score. Style smart, style fast, and walk your bride down the ramp in a look that judges cannot ignore.

What you actually do in the game:

Skincare first. Before a single jewel goes on, you run a relaxing skincare routine to give your bride a glowing base. It sets up the canvas for everything that follows.

Bridal outfit selection. Browse a wide collection of lehengas, sarees, and fusion bridal looks. Mix silhouettes, fabrics, and embroidery styles to build a look that fits the brief for each round.

Makeup studio. Choose eye shadows, lashes, liners, and lipstick shades from a full makeup kit. Subtle daytime bridal or full-on heavy glam, the call is yours.

Hair and color. Match the hairstyle and hair color to the outfit. A messy bun reads differently than a sleek updo, and the judges notice every choice.

Jewelry and accessories. Stack bangles, drop earrings, maang tikka, and nath to complete the look. Even the bindi placement is part of your score.

Fashion fight rounds. Once the look is locked in, your bride walks the ramp and competes directly against other styled brides. Win rounds to unlock pretty outfit categories, lovely jewelry sets, and late amazing makeup palettes.

Why players keep coming back:

The competition format means no two sessions feel the same. Each round brings a different style brief, so the lehenga look that scored high last time might not cut it against an evening reception theme. You have to read the brief, adapt your choices, and execute fast.

The item depth is real. Indian girl dress up games often recycle the same ten outfits. Here, the wardrobe spans traditional bridal red, pastel mint, deep jewel tones, and even indo-western crossover pieces, so there is always a combination you have not tried yet.

The progression is satisfying. Early rounds are forgiving and teach you how makeup layers and outfit pairings interact. Later rounds demand precision, and unlocking a rare jewelry set after a tough win feels genuinely earned.

If you enjoy indian girl makeup games, wedding stylist challenges, or any bridal dress up experience, this game gives you all of that inside a single competitive loop. Get Indian Bride Dress Up Games and show the ramp what real bridal styling looks like.

data.name: Conquian: Classic Card Game
data.description_full:
Conquian is a card game played with a 40-card deck, where the goal is to form melds (sets or runs) of cards. Its name derives from the Spanish phrase "con quién," meaning "with whom," reflecting its interactive and competitive nature. Over the centuries, Conquian has evolved into various forms, including the popular Rummy games we know today.

Step into the world of Conquian, the legendary ancestor of modern Rummy games! Originating in 17th-century Mexico, this traditional card game combines strategic depth with simple rules, making it a timeless favorite across generations.

Key Features:
🌟 Historical Roots: As the precursor to Rummy, Conquian preserves the essence of classic card gameplay while offering a unique cultural experience rooted in Mexican heritage.
🎓 Easy to Learn, Hard to Master: New players can grasp the basics in minutes with our intuitive tutorial. Perfect for quick matches or extended sessions!
🎨 Elegant Visual Design: Enjoy a clean, minimalist interface with vibrant card illustrations and smooth animations, ensuring a visually pleasing and distraction-free experience.
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 All-Ages Fun: Whether you’re a seasoned card enthusiast or a casual player, Conquian’s balanced mechanics appeal to men, women, and children alike. Gather the family for a round of strategic fun!
🌍 Global Popularity: From its origins in Mexico to its spread across Latin America and beyond, Conquian has captivated players worldwide. Known as Cooncan in the Southern United States and Coon Can in other regions, this game has adapted to local cultures while retaining its core charm.

📲 Download now and rediscover the charm of a game that has stood the test of time!

data.name: Get Color Pack: Sort Puzzle
data.description_full:
🧪 Get Color Pack: Sort Puzzle - A Fresh Take on Color Sorting Puzzles! 🧪
Dive into a deeply soothing and incredibly satisfying puzzle game where logic meets fluid mechanics. Your objective is crystal clear:
meticulously separate vibrant, mixed liquids so that each beautiful glass bottle contains only one unified color. With every single level you
conquer, the challenge deepens - and so does the immense satisfaction of getting that final pour just right. If you love brain teasers, color
matching, and relaxing offline games, you have found your next puzzle addiction!
💧 Simple Concept, Smart Challenges
You’re presented with an array of beautifully crafted bottles filled with chaotic, layered colors. To solve this mesmerizing water sort puzzle,
you must carefully pour liquid between the bottles, adhering to strict color-matching rules:
• Pour liquid only onto the exact same color, or into a completely empty bottle.
• Stack identical colors together until the tube is full.
• Use your available empty space strategically to maneuver trapped liquids.
• Complete the level by achieving perfectly sorted, single-color bottles.
As you progress, new layers, hidden colors, and tighter layouts appear, meaning every single decision counts.

🧠 Strategy Over Speed
Forget stressful countdowns! There’s absolutely no timer in this game - just you, your mind, and the puzzle. Take a deep breath and think
carefully before each pour. Because you are given a limited number of empty bottles, you cannot simply move colors around endlessly. To
become a master sorter, you’ll need to:
• Anticipate your future moves and visualize the flow of the puzzle.
• Uncover and free trapped colors at the bottom of the tubes.
• Prevent frustrating dead ends by planning your bottle usage.
• Reorganize efficiently with minimal space to keep your board clean.
It’s a magnificent game of foresight, clever rearranging, and cognitive training that will keep your brain sharp.
🎧 Designed to Unwind (ASMR Experience)
Step into a world of ultimate relaxation. Enjoy stunning, fluid animations and beautifully rendered, vibrant colors that make every successful
pour feel incredibly satisfying. The clean user interface, gentle pace, and soothing aesthetic create a highly relaxing environment designed

data.name: 오늘도 환생 2 : 방치형 디펜스 RPG
data.description_full:
방치형 RPG × 영웅 키우기 × 성 디펜스!
3천만 글로벌 유저가 사랑한 《오늘도 환생》의 정식 속편, 《오늘도 환생 2》가 돌아왔습니다.

끝없이 몰려오는 웨이브를 막고, 영웅을 소환하고, 환생을 통해 훈장을 모아 더 강해지세요.
방치만 해도 성장하고, 환생할수록 강해지는 정통 방치게임!
세계의 마지막 요새 ‘발키온’을 지키기 위한 새로운 모험이 시작됩니다.

▣ 게임 특징 ▣

■ 방치만 해도 성장하는 키우기 RPG
게임을 계속 조작하지 않아도 영웅은 성장합니다.
출근길, 업무 중, 잠자는 동안에도 자동 전투로 골드와 보상을 획득하세요.
바쁜 일상 속에서도 부담 없이 즐길 수 있는 정통 방치형 RPG입니다.

■ 끝없이 이어지는 웨이브와 성 디펜스
심연의 군단이 끝없는 웨이브로 몰려옵니다.
영웅을 배치하고, 스킬을 활용하고, 성을 강화하여 적의 공격을 막아내세요.
단순한 자동 전투를 넘어, 영웅 배치와 성장 전략이 중요한 디펜스 RPG의 재미를 느낄 수 있습니다.

■ 환생과 훈장으로 무한 성장
강한 적에게 막혔다면 환생하세요!
환생을 통해 획득한 훈장으로 영웅과 성을 영구적으로 강화할 수 있습니다.
환생을 반복할수록 더 높은 웨이브에 도전할 수 있으며, 당신의 기사단은 점점 더 강력해집니다.
방치형 RPG의 핵심 재미인 무한 성장을 제대로 경험해보세요.

■ 다양한 영웅 소환과 수집
인간, 엘프, 언데드, 오크 — 네 종족의 영웅들이 당신의 소환을 기다립니다.
각 영웅은 고유한 능력과 스킬을 가지고 있으며, 조합에 따라 전투 스타일이 달라집니다.
영웅 소환, 캐릭터 수집, 전략 배치를 통해 나만의 최강 기사단을 완성하세요.

■ 성을 키우고 전장을 지배하세요
성은 전장의 중심이자 마지막 방어선입니다.
성의 내구도, 공격력, 공격 속도, 사거리 등을 강화하여 더 오래 버티고 더 강하게 반격하세요.
영웅 키우기와 성 키우기가 함께 어우러진 새로운 방치형 디펜스 게임입니다.

■ 승리를 돕는 비술과 유물
종족별 비술로 전투를 더욱 빠르고 강력하게 진행하세요.
퀘스트 자동 완료, 웨이브 스킵, 스킬 쿨타임 감소, 웨이브 당기기 등 다양한 효과가 성장 속도를 높여줍니다.
던전에서 획득한 재료로 유물을 강화하면 기사단의 능력을 더욱 극대화할 수 있습니다.

■ 지루할 틈 없는 다양한 콘텐츠
강력한 보스가 기다리는 던전!
시즌제로 운영되는 무한 랭킹전!
매일 새로운 기록에 도전하는 일일 랭킹전!
전 세계 유저들과 경쟁하며 더 높은 순위와 보상을 노려보세요.

■ 바쁜 유저를 위한 편의 시스템
자동 전투, 배속 시스템, 일괄 레벨업, 웨이브 당기기 등 빠른 성장을 돕는 기능을 제공합니다.
짧은 시간만 접속해도 성장의 재미를 느낄 수 있으며, 오래 플레이할수록 더욱 깊은 전략을 즐길 수 있습니다.

▣ 이런 분들께 추천합니다 ▣

- 《오늘도 환생》을 재미있게 즐기셨던 분
- 방치형 RPG, 방치게임, 키우기 게임을 좋아하는 분

- 디펜스, 성 지키기, 웨이브 전투를 좋아하는 분
- 자동 전투와 오토 플레이로 가볍게 즐길 게임을 찾는 분
- 무과금, 소과금으로도 꾸준히 성장하는 게임을 원하는 분
- 짧게 접속해도 보람 있는 성장형 RPG를 찾는 분

▣ 왜 《오늘도 환생 2》인가? ▣

- 3천만 글로벌 유저가 사랑한 원작의 정식 속편

data.description_full:
Royal Fruit is a relaxing 2048-style puzzle with a bright fruit theme. Slide numbered fruit tiles across the board, merge matching pairs, and work your way up to the 2048 tile — and beyond.

Every swipe moves all tiles at once, so each turn takes a bit of planning. The board slowly fills up, and the round ends when no moves are left. Simple rules, plenty of strategy.

HOW TO PLAY
• Swipe up, down, left or right to move every tile on the board
• When two tiles with the same number touch, they merge into one
• Keep merging to reach the 2048 tile — then keep going for a higher score
• The round ends when the board is full and no moves remain

FEATURES
• Classic 2048 merge mechanics with a colorful fruit look
• Easy one-finger swipe controls
• Score, moves, time and top-tile tracking during each round
• Personal best score saved between sessions
• Clean, bright arcade-style visuals
• Sound effects you can turn on or off
• Works offline — no internet connection needed to play

Train your logic and planning a few minutes at a time. Can you build the 2048 tile? Download Royal Fruit and find out!

data.name: Patch Panic: Merge Harvest
data.description_full:
Welcome to a fresh and challenging vegetable-themed puzzle game set on your dining table!

This game uses classic match-3 mechanics: match three identical vegetable blocks to clear them from the board. But there’s a twist — the blocks are stacked in multiple overlapping layers, and only the topmost visible blocks can be matched and removed. Carefully plan and clear upper layers to reveal and access the blocks underneath.

You must also manage a limited number of placeholders at the bottom of the screen where matched blocks are placed before clearance. If these placeholders fill up before you can clear the blocks, the game ends. This combination of layered blocks and finite placeholders creates a thrilling challenge that exercises both your strategic thinking and quick decision-making skills.

Dive into this addictive puzzle, match crunchy carrots, leafy greens, and more to clear levels and unlock surprises.

data.name: Mesozoic Dawn
data.description_full:
The Miracle of Life Begins Here

In MESOZOIC DAWN, you don't just play a multiplayer dinosaur survival game—離ou live an evolutionary journey spanning hundreds of millions of years. Start as a vulnerable juvenile, then forage, stalk, and grow in a perilous prehistoric wild. Breakthrough your genetic limits via the core "Egg Evolution" system to claim your place at the top of the food chain!

---

✨ Core Features

🦖 A Massive Ecosystem
A unique Low Poly style brings over 70+ prehistoric species to life across sea, land, and air. Every creature possesses its own distinct survival instincts.

🧬 Unique Evolution System
Forget tedious XP bars. Progress through "Growth + Nesting = Evolution." Consume nutrient-rich food and breed to unlock more powerful prehistoric apex predators.

🫀 Hardcore Survival Mechanics
Stomach, lungs, and heart are interconnected. Hunger, stress, or injury directly damage organs and lower efficiency. Temperature, humidity, oxygen, and energy create a strict survival web where every choice matters.

⚔️ Strategic Combat
Featuring skill buffs, penetration, resilience, and a Locational Damage System. Striking different body parts yields unique damage multipliers and defensive returns. True Damage bypasses armor to deplete health and inflict trauma—high trauma will leave even fully armored players in despair by blocking heart health recovery.

🐣 Nesting and Breeding
• Diverse Paths: Choose parthenogenesis or find a mate. Temperature determines the offspring's gender; males naturally possess size and combat advantages.
• Build Your Nest: Gather stone and wood to build a nest that serves as your safe haven and respawn point. Defend it, as hostile players can destroy it.
• 🆕 Enhanced Brooding: Manually brooding eggs doubles hatching speed and stacks across generations to secure the strongest bloodline.

🧬 Genetic Inheritance
Offspring inherit traits from parents, with stats randomly breaking through limits. Shape a unique, peak bloodline through generations and selective brooding bonuses.

🤖 🆕 AI Companion & Offspring System
• Tame Wild Mates: Interact with opposite-sex wild dinosaurs of your species to build favorability and tame them as your exclusive AI mate.
• AI Offspring Management: Hatch eggs into AI offspring that follow your commands as loyal combat followers and territory guardians.
• Combat Commands: Issue orders like Follow, Attack Target, Standby, Defend, Protect, and Evade. AI companions assess threats and execute tactics independently.

🤖 Dynamic AI Herds
Encounter neutral and hostile AI herds with distinct behaviors. During special seasons, witness epic, massive migrations—a thrilling spectacle that brings both extreme danger and unmatched opportunity.

🌡️ Dynamic Climate Zones
The world is divided into distinct climate zones. Different species require specific temperature and humidity levels. Finding your ideal zone ensures survival and accelerates growth.

🌐 Online Multiplayer
Hunt with allies or clash with rival player clans over territory, water, and food. Full community server support lets you forge your own prehistoric world.

---

Are you ready for the Mesozoic Dawn?

data.name: Sky Build
data.description_full:
Feel the thrill with Sky Build and test your reaction speed! 🏗️⚡ Your task is to fill all three slots with the same symbol before time runs out.

The slots with three symbols quickly and cyclically change icons 🔄 Tap on a slot to lock the current symbol and tapping again will unlock it, but it will cost you 2 seconds ⏳ Plan your actions carefully, because every second counts.

Once all three slots are locked, the result is checked 🎯 If the symbols match, you win! If not, the slots will automatically unlock, giving you a chance to try again. For the daring, there is a “build” button 🚀 that locks all slots at once — a risky but sometimes very profitable move.

When the time runs out, the symbols are fixed where they stopped ⏱️ If they are the same, you win; if they are different, the game is over. Each level has a different time limit and the first stages are a little easier to start with. Sky Build is all about speed, strategy and excitement in every round!

data.description_full:
Obby Prison Escape 3D is an exciting obstacle escape game where players must find their way out of Barry's high security prison. Run, jump, and carefully move through challenging obby levels filled with traps, moving platforms, and dangerous obstacles.

Each level tests your timing, reflexes, and parkour skills as you dodge hazards and avoid getting caught. The fast paced gameplay keeps every escape attempt intense, making each run feel fresh and rewarding.

With smooth 3D controls and simple mechanics, the game is easy to play but challenging to master. As you progress, the difficulty increases, pushing you to improve your movement and precision with every stage.

Featuring fun obby parkour gameplay, creative prison environments, and nonstop action, this game delivers an addictive experience for fans of obby, parkour, and prison escape games. Do you have what it takes to complete every level and escape the prison?

🚀 Game Features

• Smooth and responsive parkour controls

• Challenging obby levels set inside detailed prison environments

• Dangerous obstacles including lasers, traps, and moving platforms

• Smart guard avoidance and multiple escape paths
